title: Enterprise Account Executive - FR/BNL/SE (m/f/x)
description: Account Executive (m/f/x) (French Speaking) Location: EU (Remote) Comp: 120k EUR base Territories: France / Benelux / Southern Europe Who You’ll Work For: At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. Who we're looking for: As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Account Executives who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location. The role: Own and grow a defined territory of named enterprise accounts across France / Benelux / Southern Europe. Take commercial ownership of the full sales cycle, from identifying and developing new opportunities through to negotiation, closing and account expansion. Deliver an individual annual revenue target of €1.1M once ramped, driving new business acquisition and growth within existing accounts. Build and develop a sustainable pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities, supported by SDRs and strategic partners. Lead complex enterprise sales engagements, typically involving deal values of €150K–€300K, multiple stakeholders and extended sales cycles. Develop strategic relationships with enterprise customers, technology partners and consulting firms to drive commercial opportunities. Position and sell complex, data-driven SaaS solutions to large enterprise organisations, translating technical capabilities into measurable business value. Support the introduction and commercialisation of new products, helping establish market presence and identify new growth opportunities. Excellent proficiency in French verbal and written skills. Proven ability to sell complex, high-value SaaS solutions into large enterprise organisations, managing long sales cycles and significant deal values. Ability to develop territory strategies, build account plans and identify opportunities for new business acquisition and account expansion. Strong hunting mentality with the ability to independently identify, engage and convert new enterprise prospects. Skilled in navigating multi-stakeholder sales processes, coordinating internal and external teams and managing sophisticated commercial negotiations. Ability to understand complex customer challenges, conduct effective discovery and position solutions around business outcomes rather than product features. Strong commercial acumen and ability to build business cases, demonstrate ROI and communicate the financial and operational value of technology investments. Experience working alongside technology, consulting and implementation partners to develop opportunities and close enterprise deals. Ability to understand and communicate complex data-driven technology, analytics, software and technical solutions to both technical and business stakeholders. Practical experience applying structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Force Management or similar enterprise sales frameworks. Ability to prioritise named accounts, identify whitespace opportunities and develop strategic approaches to maximise territory revenue. Strong negotiation skills with the ability to manage commercial objections, procurement processes and executive-level discussions. Comfortable operating in a changing environment, launching new products and navigating ambiguity. Proficiency with modern sales tools, including HubSpot, Microsoft Office 365 and pipeline forecasting platforms. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage and influence senior executives and technical decision-makers. Nice to have: experience selling services. Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. What We Offer: Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. The Experience: Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here Diversity and Inclusion If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed. At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer, Clinical AI Devices
description: Job Summary In the Clinical AI Devices team, the Software Engineer is primarily responsible for building and maintaining software in the Clinical AI domain, from wrapping deep learning models into containerized medical devices, to integration with other systems. This work spans all of the company's medical devices, across the main radiology modalities: X-Ray, CT, MRI, and Mammography. The focus of the current role is at the interface between product logic and the underlying serving platform, ensuring that requests are correctly validated, routed, and that results are properly assembled and returned. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Participate in the software development process: design, refine, and develop new features, and maintain existing ones. Write code, review teammates' code, and contribute to the testing framework through automated and manual tests. Work with the team lead and product manager to refine requirements. Own features and projects end-to-end, from refinement to production. Flag risks and bugs by keeping the radiologist's workflow in mind. Support service and delivery teams with production issues. Ensure compliance with Quality and Regulatory requirements throughout the development cycle, including technical documentation (e.g. implementation specs), cybersecurity processes, and risk analysis. Collaborate with the team on strategic recommendations and improvements to technology and business. PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned, and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time. Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in a related field such as computer science, biomedical engineering or similar (required). Experience (required): at least 5 years of experience in a similar or related relevant role At least 5 years of experience working with Java, with proficiency in Spring Boot (required). Fluent in English (required). Accustomed to CI/CD practice (required). Familiar with test-driven development and testing frameworks like JUnit (required). Experience working with docker, cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS, and Kubernetes (required). Experience working with Agentic Coding tools like Claude and Cursor (preferred). Experience working with microservices and distributed systems (preferred). Experience in the MedTech field, e.g. working with DICOM data, AI algorithms, and clinical workflows (preferred). What we value Strong analytical mindset. Not afraid of working inside a strong regulatory framework and disciplined about testing needs. Ability to make well-reasoned trade-offs between velocity and quality, understanding when to work for higher quality and when to optimize for time-to-market. You collaborate openly, support your colleagues, and contribute to shared success. Quality Standards Communicate, cooperate, and consistently function professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors. Demonstrate initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercise confidentiality in all areas of performance. Follow all local, regional, and country laws concerning employment. Follow all DeepHealth policies and procedures. Follow data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times. Practice universal safety precautions. Promote good public relations on the phone and in person. Adapt and willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems. Report to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meals and rest breaks, and maintain satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines. Complete job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner. Travel This position requires domestic / international travel up to 10%. Working Environment Hybrid, remote-friendly Based in France (we have offices in Paris and Grenoble) or in the Netherlands (we have offices in Rotterdam and Amsterdam) Salary: Dependent upon experience: 60,000-80,000 EURO Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer, Canvas Core
description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Canvas Core team builds and maintains the foundational platform that powers Mural’s visual thinking experience. This includes the infinite canvas, key editor components, document editing behaviors, asset management, real-time collaboration, and the systems that enable fast, reliable, and intuitive interaction on the canvas. We’re also responsible for the Mural UI, the real-time message protocol that enables seamless remote collaboration, and the developer-friendly APIs that internal teams use to build features like diagramming, workshops, presentations, integrations, and AI-enabled product capabilities. Our mission is to ensure the Mural editor is fast, reliable, intuitive, and easy to build on. We prioritize performance, simplicity, developer experience, and platform quality, enabling teams across the company to ship quickly and safely on top of Canvas Core. YOUR MISSION As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll help design, build, and improve the Canvas platform so that the Mural editor remains reliable, high-performing, and intuitive for our users. You’ll work on the systems that power real-time collaboration, shared document editing, spatial interactions, rendering and interaction performance, asset management, developer APIs, and AI-enabled product capabilities across the Mural editor. Your role will be to reduce platform complexity, improve the quality and speed of Canvas development, and help teams ship high-quality editor experiences quickly and safely. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and other stakeholders to turn ambiguous product and platform problems into clear, maintainable technical solutions. Senior Engineers at Mural lead by example through strong technical execution, thoughtful design, high-quality implementation, and collaborative problem-solving. They help raise the bar for their team through design discussions, code reviews, mentoring, documentation, and pragmatic improvements to engineering practices. WHAT YOU’LL DO Own and deliver new Canvas platform capabilities and improvements from problem definition through implementation, release, measurement, and iteration Partner with Product and Design to shape high-quality user experiences, balancing pragmatic technical delivery with long-term platform needs Design and build maintainable Canvas platform systems, with accountability for quality, performance, reliability, and developer experience Contribute to developer-friendly APIs, service boundaries, and platform contracts that internal teams can build on quickly and safely Use AI-assisted tools and agentic workflows as part of your engineering practice to prototype, implement, test, document, and measure work effectively Strengthen the team through technical design reviews, demos, code reviews, mentoring, and improvements to engineering practices Build and evolve canvas systems with rich document and object models, including hierarchical scene or document structures, spatial indexing and querying, layout behavior, asset management, and selection mechanics Work on large-scale concurrent and real-time collaboration systems that keep shared documents synchronized across users, contributing to design decisions around event ordering, latency, conflict handling, and failure-mode management Help design, build, and integrate AI-enabled product capabilities where they intersect with the canvas, document model, real-time collaboration systems, or developer platform Improve performance through profiling, bottleneck analysis, architectural simplification, targeted optimization, and moving expensive work out of critical interaction paths so systems remain responsive as document complexity and user activity scale WHAT YOU’LL BRING Fluency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript, with familiarity in React, Node.js, or comparable modern frameworks 6+ years building and shipping large-scale production software as part of an agile engineering team Strong engineering judgment, with experience designing and delivering scalable, reliable, high-performance systems and developer-facing abstractions that balance simplicity, developer experience, and title: Senior Financial Systems Engineer (m/f/d)
description: We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning. If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz! About the role Berlitz is rebuilding its commercial and financial platform. That includes a new CRM, usage-based billing, modern payment processing, and a consolidated ERP, all supporting new digital products for learners, teachers, and enterprise customers. We're looking for a Senior Financial Systems Engineer to own the flow of money through that platform, from quote and checkout through billing and payment to the general ledger. You'll be the technical authority on how our systems exchange financial data. You'll make sure every customer, invoice, payment, refund, and credit reconciles cleanly at month-end. This is a hands-on engineering role that sits at the intersection of engineering and finance. You'll report into Engineering and work day to day with Finance, RevOps, and our external NetSuite implementation partner. What you'll do Own the architecture and data contracts for our order-to-cash flow across HubSpot, Stripe, Adyen, Metronome, and NetSuite. Build and maintain integrations using NetSuite SuiteScript and REST/SuiteTalk, PSP APIs and webhooks, and our iPaaS (Workato), choosing custom code or low-code where each makes sense. Design reconciliation between payment processors, billing, bank settlements, and the ledger, and build the jobs, alerts, and audit trails that keep it reliable. Model prepaid credit packages and usage-based consumption correctly, including deferred revenue, drawdown, expiry, refunds, and credit notes. Support multi-entity, multi-currency operations, including subsidiaries, intercompany flows, FX, and tax handling. Act as the technical counterpart to our NetSuite implementation partner: review designs, challenge assumptions, and take ownership of what they build. Partner with Finance to shorten and de-risk month-end close by removing manual work and fixing data quality at the source. Document the financial data model and integrations so the platform is supportable beyond you. What you'll bring 6+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years building or owning financial, billing, or payments systems. Hands-on NetSuite development experience (SuiteScript 2.x, REST/SuiteTalk, saved searches) and a solid understanding of its record model, including customers, sales orders, invoices, payments, deposits, and journals. Production experience integrating Stripe and/or Adyen, including webhooks, idempotency, payouts and settlement reports, disputes, and fees. Real accounting literacy. You can explain revenue recognition, deferred revenue, cash application, and bank reconciliation, and you know why they matter to Finance. Strong integration engineering fundamentals: API design, event-driven patterns, retries and error handling, and data validation. Comfort working across teams and translating between engineers, accountants, and commercial stakeholders. Good judgement under deadline pressure, with the ability to ship pragmatically without creating reconciliation debt. Nice to have Experience with usage-based or consumption billing platforms (Metronome, Orb, Chargebee, or similar). Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or other CRM-to-ERP integrations. iPaaS experience (Workato, Boomi, Celigo, MuleSoft). Experience migrating from a legacy billing or CRM system to a new stack. Exposure to SOC 2 / ISO 27001 controls around financial systems. Experience at a multi-country business or in education / subscription services. What success looks like First 90 days: You understand our current order-to-cash flows end to end. You've taken technical ownership of the payments-to-ledger integration and identified the biggest reconciliation risks. First 6 months: New products bill, collect, and post to NetSuite correctly across entities and currencies. Month-end reconciliation between PSPs and the ledger is largely automated. First year: Our financial systems are well documented, monitored, and trusted by Finance, and they're ready to scale to new products and markets. Why Berlitz A rare chance to shape a financial platform nearly from scratch at a global brand with a long history. Direct impact on how the company operates and reports, with high visibility across Engineering, Finance, and leadership. A team that values pragmatic engineering and cross-functional ownership. At Berlitz, connecting people across languages and cultures is at the heart of what we do. Our global workplace reflects the diverse world we serve, bringing together different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We create an inclusive environment where everyone has an equal opportunity to belong, contribute and grow. Ready to shape what’s next? Join us and help build the future with us. Strong understanding of Japan's financial regulatory framework, particularly JFSA requirements and regulations governing crypto-asset exchange service providers. Previous experience engaging directly with the JFSA or other Japanese financial regulators, including regulatory examinations, reporting and remediation activities. Demonstrated experience developing and overseeing compliance frameworks, policies, internal controls and regulatory governance. Strong knowledge of AML/CFT requirements, transaction monitoring, customer due diligence and financial crime controls. Experience managing regulatory findings, compliance gaps and remediation programmes. Ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders and global compliance teams in an international organisation. Professional fluency in Japanese and strong English communication skills. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company. We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! THE OPPORTUNITY We are hiring a Staff Corporate Network Engineer in our CorpIT area in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil. You will own the technical direction, architecture, and reliability of Wellhub's corporate network, from office LAN and WAN to SASE, SSE, ZTNA, and cloud connectivity. CorpIT builds scalable, data-driven solutions that raise Wellhubber productivity. This role is a senior technical leadership position within CorpIT's IT Infrastructure: you will design and evolve the networks every Wellhubber relies on daily, act as the final escalation point when things break, and raise the technical bar of the engineers around you through automation, design reviews, and mentorship. YOUR IMPACT Define the long-term strategy and reference architectures for our corporate network — LAN, WAN/SD-WAN, SASE, SSE, ZTNA, and cloud connectivity (AWS, GCP, Azure) — translating a long-term vision into time-bound, executable milestones. Partner closely with Infosec to move from perimeter-based networking to a Zero Trust model, keeping policies, tunnels, and access rules aligned with the company's risk posture. Act as the primary escalation point for critical incidents, complex outages, and major infrastructure upgrades — leading incident response and blameless post-incident reviews. Build network automation workflows using scripting and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) principles, reducing manual toil and configuration drift so most changes never need to reach you. Lead design reviews and document decisions (architecture decision records, platform overviews, runbooks), evaluating vendors and technologies with clear trade-offs on security, cost, performance, and operability. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on troubleshooting best practices, operational safety, and network design. Partner with Security, Systems, Cloud, and Application teams to roll out new technologies securely and with minimal user impact. Define and track the metrics that matter — availability, latency, incident volume, mean time to resolve, and change success rate — and report progress transparently to stakeholders. Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues'. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness. WHO YOU ARE You are a hands-on network engineer who thinks like an architect - equally comfortable troubleshooting a routing issue at 2 a.m. and designing a multi-year network roadmap. You have owned enterprise networks end-to-end before: not just keeping them running, but shaping where they go next, how they are secured, and how they are automated. What You Bring to the Table: Enterprise Networking Expertise: Hands-on enterprise networking experience, typically progressing from senior or core network engineering roles; deep knowledge of TCP/IP, routing (BGP, OSPF), switching, DNS, and VPN. SASE / SSE / ZTNA: hands-on experience designing and operating SD-WAN and cloud secure access platforms (e.g., Zscaler ZIA/ZPA, Netskope, Palo Alto Prisma, or equivalent), partnering with security teams on policy design. Cloud Connectivity: experience with cloud networking (VPC/VNet design, hybrid connectivity, transit and peering) in at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Automation & IaC: proficiency in scripting and Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Python, Terraform, Ansible), with versioning, peer review, and CI/CD applied to network changes. Technical Leadership: proven track record leading complex incidents and major infrastructure changes, and acting as the escalation point and subject-matter expert for the network. Mentorship: ability to coach junior and mid-level engineers and raise the team's technical bar through documentation, knowledge sharing, and review practices. Security & Compliance Mindset: comfortable partnering with Infosec on audits, risk assessments, and compliance requirements (e.g., PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2) tied to network design. Education & Certifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent professional experience). Industry credentials such as CCIE or equivalent multi-vendor proficiencies (Arista, AWS, Azure) are heavily preferred. Communication: a clear, structured communicator who can translate technical trade-offs into business terms for leadership and influence stakeholders in a highly matrixed environment; fluent in written and spoken English. We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior hands-on enterprise networking experience, experience with SASE/SSE/ZTNA platforms, network automation (scripting and IaC), and advanced/fluent English are mandatory requirements. WHAT WE OFFER YOU With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs! Our benefits include: WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content. HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance. FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines. PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday! PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube ! Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. title: Binance Accelerator Program - User Communications Specialist (Chinese Content)
description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world. About Binance Accelerator Program Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE . Who may apply Current university students and recent graduates. *Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws About the Role: As a User Communications Intern on the Binance User Comms team, you will help shape how millions of Chinese-speaking users experience Binance. You will review and refine the Chinese announcements and FAQs that business units publish to a global audience; ensuring every piece reads natively, and that it meets Binance's standards for accuracy, clarity, and tone. Your reviews will catch discrepancies against English source content before they reach users, and your feedback will help build the glossaries, guidelines, and AI-assisted tooling that raise the bar for Chinese content across the company. You will work closely with teams across every Binance business unit, alongside the wider content and social teams. What You’ll Do: Review Chinese announcements and FAQs for linguistic accuracy, readability, and brand consistency for Chinese-speaking audience. Cross-check Chinese content against English source materials to identify inaccuracies, inconsistencies, misleading expressions, and potential risks before publication. Deliver reviews within tight turnaround times, prioritizing effectively and handling urgent and P0 content with speed and care. Ensure consistent terminology, formatting, and style across all publications. Support end-to-end publishing operations, uploading content to the CMS and coordinating localization and distribution to other channels. Identify recurring content and language issues, review existing templates, and contribute feedback that shapes the team's review guidelines, glossaries, and SOPs; assist in developing AI-assisted tools for announcement review. What We’re Looking For: Proficiency in Chinese with strong writing skills and a sharp eye for language nuances. Good command of English (IELTS 6.5 or above), with the ability to accurately understand English source materials. Meticulous and detail-oriented; announcements are dense with dates, numbers, and product details, and small errors matter. Excellent proofreading, editing, and communication skills, with the ability to multi-task and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities. Comfortable using AI-assisted writing and productivity tools to support reviews. Stay up to date with trending topics on social media. Interest in crypto and blockchain, and familiarity with Binance products, is a plus. Availability: Full-time (5 days per week), remote, 6-month contract. Why Binance Shape the future of finance Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning Competitive salary and company benefits Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team) Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success. By submitting a job application, you acknowledge that you have read our Candidate Privacy Notice . We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Director of Brand Strategy
description: Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion! Funny name, serious business We are a leading eco-friendly household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2026, we’ve contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we’re really good at making it easy to do good. We operate scaling businesses the UK, US, Australia and Canada. Our amazing team is based in Australia, the UK, the Philippines, China, and the US. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services. A bit about the role The team have been busy building an ownable and distinctive brand platform. This role is about what comes next - the second album. You’ll partner with our Chief Creative & Brand Officer to set the brand strategy for the coming year and the brand horizon for the next three to five, built on a real understanding of how our customers’ lives are changing rather than a deck full of numbers. You’ll also be the person who turns messy inputs into a problem worth solving. Requests reach our creative team from markets and teams across the business, each with different goals and levels of detail. It can take our creative team hours to shape them into clear briefs before they can start. You’ll define what great briefing looks like here, help the business work out which work is genuinely worth making and give creative teams a sharp starting point every time. It’s a role with real room to shape things. We’re a business that has grown quickly and now spans four markets, and the joins between global brand thinking and local market plans are still being drawn. You get to draw a lot of them. This role is fully remote but must be based in our Australian Hub. If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in Sprinting on our brand positioning with the Chief Creative & Brand Officer - and telling us which bits of it don’t hold up yet. Sitting with our Consumer Insights lead to work out how our customers’ lives at home are likely to change over the next three to five years, and what that means for the brand. Taking a brief for one of our biggest campaigns and rewriting it into something a creative team can run at. Meeting brand leads and general managers across Australia, the UK, the US and Canada to find out what’s in their plans, and where a single brand approach would make everyone’s life easier. Shaping a set of small, bold experiments to test what “a brand that punches above its weight” really means for us. Acting as a thought partner on our social and content strategy so it pulls in the same direction as the long-term brand strategy. Let’s talk about you You get a kick out of making messy things simple. You’ve been handed the ten-page document with no question in it, and you enjoyed finding the question. The craft you’re proudest of is probably a short, sharp brief rather than a long, clever deck – because you know the brief is where great work either becomes possible or quietly doesn’t. Most people who thrive here have come from an agency planning background, though we’re not precious about it if you’ve built this muscle somewhere else. You think in years, not weeks. At least half your time in this role should be spent on what’s coming, not on fixing what’s already landed. You’re genuinely curious about customers and culture, you can point to brand bets you made a few years ago and say honestly which ones played out, and you can hold a three to five year view and this quarter’s campaign in your head at the same time. You’re deeply collaborative, and you’ll still tell us we’re wrong. You listen properly, you build relationships across time zones without being asked to, and you notice when a market has gone quiet. You’re also the person who says “hang on, how does this connect to the five-year plan?” when the room is getting carried away. That healthy tension is the job, not a side effect of it – and you can bring the commercial argument that makes the challenge land. You give a crap. title: Enterprise Account Executive, CEE
description: Get to Know Us Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. title: Threat Intelligence Analyst, Crypto (Transnational Crime Organizations)
description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. About the role We're looking for a Blockchain Intelligence Analyst to operate as a high-judgment, high-autonomy individual contributor specializing in transnational criminal organisations. You will use blockchain analytics, open-source and closed-source intelligence, and cryptocurrency attribution to trace the proceeds of drug trafficking, identify the networks that move them, and produce intelligence that helps TRM and its partners disrupt illicit drug activity. This is not a people-management role. We're looking for an experienced analyst who can independently lead complex investigations, develop high-confidence assessments, uncover novel attribution, and raise the team's tradecraft through technical expertise and example. This role will require proactive work with law enforcement partners, often picking up a stalled investigation, finding what was missed, and linking it to other cases. You should be equally comfortable tracing funds across blockchains, identifying laundering and cash-out infrastructure, correlating on-chain and off-chain signals, and turning fragmented data into clear, defensible intelligence that enables partners to make informed operational decisions. The impact you will have Produce finished intelligence on transnational criminal organisations, vendors, facilitators and laundering pathways, including actor profiles, lead packages and attribution assessments suitable for investigative, executive and partner audiences. Lead complex end-to-end blockchain investigations from initial seed indicators, such as addresses, transactions, exchange exposure and infrastructure leads, through to full attribution. Trace illicit proceeds across multiple blockchains, bridges, mixers, peel chains and nested services, identifying controllers, counterparties and cash-out points, including OTC desks, ATM networks and cash-to-crypto services. Correlate on-chain activity with OSINT, closed-source intelligence and off-chain identity or infrastructure signals to build a complete picture of how transnational criminal organisations operate and move value. Own investigative work-streams from discovery through validation and written production, drafting intelligence that is source-cited, auditable and operationally useful. Build and maintain strong working relationships with law enforcement partners, so that our intelligence reflects real investigative tradecraft and gets used. Help strengthen TRM's transnational criminal organisations coverage by contributing new attributions, refining investigative methodology and improving repeatable workflows. Support briefings, partner engagements and capability-building sessions where tracing and attribution tradecraft must be explained clearly and credibly. What success looks like You generate meaningful attribution and investigative leads in cases where the answers are not obvious and the financial trail is deliberately obscured. You consistently produce finished intelligence that partners trust and use. Your work helps TRM and its partners move faster on high-priority narcotics activity without sacrificing rigor, auditability or defensibility. You improve team capability by mentoring peers, refining tradecraft and strengthening repeatable workflows. What we're looking for Professional experience: 5+ years in blockchain intelligence, crypto investigations, financial-crime or narcotics investigations, threat intelligence, or a comparable senior analytical role. Blockchain tracing expertise: deep hands-on experience tracing funds across multiple blockchains and through laundering or obfuscation techniques such as mixers, chain-hopping, bridges, peel chains and layered cash-out behavior. Investigative tradecraft: demonstrated ability to independently run complex investigations and synthesize findings into clear written intelligence products, including assessments, lead packages, fund-flow analysis and attribution reporting. Strong communication: especially the ability to turn technically complex findings into understandable, actionable intelligence for government and private-sector audiences. Judgment and execution: sound judgment and curiosity, and the ability to operate in a fast-moving environment where outputs must still stand up to scrutiny. AI fluency: experience using AI tools and large language models to accelerate research and augment analytical workflows, with the ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and relevance. Preferred qualifications Experience in government, national security, law enforcement, or a mature private-sector investigations or threat intelligence program. Familiarity with darknet markets, drug-trafficking networks, OTC and ATM laundering Familiarity with OSINT and with combining blockchain activity with off-chain signals and adversary behavior. Comfort with modern investigative tooling, including AI and structured data environments such as TRM, Maltego, Palantir or similar platforms. About the Team The team operates within TRM’s Blockchain Intelligence organization, alongside threat intelligence analysts, on-chain investigators, and law enforcement partners Blockchain Intelligence Analysts are the operational core, converting on-chain tracing and off-chain intelligence into attribution and actionable leads on transnational criminal organizations Distributed team with an async-first approach via Slack and Notion, plus structured syncs for alignment High autonomy, high standards, low bureaucracy. You’ll work directly with analysts, engineers, and customers who depend on your output Team Operating Rhythms Weekly team syncs to align on priorities and review active casework Regular async updates via Slack on active investigations, attribution work, and leads in flight Primary time zone overlap: Working hours should overlap with both UK and US business hours All output documented in Notion and TRM’s investigative tools Surge availability expected when partners need a fast turnaround Join Our Mission We seek people whose work matters, who build with speed and rigor, and who take pride in protecting others through their craft. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, apply anyway. Build to protect civilization. Let’s do it together. Application Instructions If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered. Interviewing with TRM Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview. Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role. Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact. First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role. Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM. References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact. Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details. Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you! Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way. AI Fluency at TRM AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM. We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks. At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to: Accelerate repeatable workflows Structure and solve problems Improve output quality Increase speed and leverage You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process. Life at TRM We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day. TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving. At TRM, you should expect: Priorities and targets to change quickly Operating with a high degree of ambiguity A high level of personal ownership and accountability Close collaboration across teams and functions Frequent, high-touch communication Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment. We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Leadership Principles We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly. Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday. Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger. Join our Mission At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New
