title: Data Scientist, Enterprise Analytics
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h1><strong>An Overview of this role</strong></h1> <p>As a Data Scientist at GitLab on the Enterprise Analytics team,  you’ll be a trusted analytical partner to Sales, Revenue Operations, and Finance, helping define how we measure go-to-market performance and where we invest to grow. This is a strategic and hands-on role. You’ll apply statistical, experimentation, and machine learning methods to forecast outcomes, explain what drives activation, conversion, expansion, and retention, and size opportunities. You’ll also support the company-level reporting and GTM performance views that executives use to run the business, covering consumption, ARR, and first orders.</p> <h1><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h1> <ul> <li>Embed yourself with business teams to become a trusted partner supporting insight generation and strategic decision making across GTM.</li> <li>Perform exploratory data analysis to uncover behavioral trends, long-term patterns, and the key drivers and levers behind business performance, and communicate their impact clearly to non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Build and productionize machine learning models - such as propensity, product-qualified lead (PQL) scoring, churn, and expansion models - including training, validation, testing, and feature engineering, using MLOps practices and tooling (CI/CD for ML pipelines, model registries, automated retraining, and monitoring) to move work reliably from notebook to production</li> <li>Design, run, and evaluate growth experiments (A/B tests and quasi-experiments) on onboarding, pricing and packaging, and upgrade flows, and measure their impact on activation, conversion, and retention</li> <li>Build and operationalize agentic workflows for analysis, modeling, and pipeline automation, with evaluation and monitoring that keep agent-generated insights accurate, traceable, and trustworthy.</li> <li>Contribute to GitLab’s Semantic Layer enabling stakeholders and agents to self-serve metrics using trusts and tested sources.</li> <li>Write production-grade Python and SQL that meets internal standards for style, maintainability, and performance in a high-scale database environment; maintain and advocate for these standards through code review</li> </ul> <h1><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h1> <ul> <li>3-5 years of professional experience in GTM analytics, data science, or a similar technical role</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear, measurable questions and communicate technical concepts effectively to non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience with experimentation and causal inference (A/B testing, power analysis, quasi-experimental methods) and with statistical and machine learning methods such as regression, classification, clustering, and survival analysis</li> <li>Deep, hands-on understanding of SQL in cloud data warehouses (like Snowflake SQL), including working with product usage and event data, and in business intelligence tools (Looker, Tableau, Hex, or similar)</li> <li>Experience using Python for statistical modeling, machine learning, and production data science. With hands-on experience in pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Jupyter, and related libraries such as LightGBM and XGBoost</li> <li>Hands-on experience building agentic workflows with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, OpenCode, or similar), including connecting agents to the right context, tools, and platforms such as MLflow, and evaluating their output for accuracy and reliability.</li> <li>Experience working in a B2C company working with motions and metrics, including Consumption, CRR, ARR, and Churn & Contraction</li> <li>Self-motivated and self-managing, with strong organizational skills</li> <li>Ability to use GitLab and to thrive in a fully remote organization</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the Team</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong>The Enterprise Analytics team builds the trusted data products and insights behind GitLab’s Company wide sales, revenue, and finance reporting. We work across the business on metrics including First Orders, pipeline, CRR, ARR, and other key indicators, helping leaders make informed decisions and teams understand how their work contributes to GitLab’s growth.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

This is not a feature-delivery role. title: Développeur fullstack confirmé H/F (C#, .Net, Angular)
description: À propos de N2JSoft N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles. Fondée en 2015, elle compte aujourd’hui 20 000 clients et 1M utilisateurs dans 98 pays , faisant de N2F l’un des leaders du marché français. N2F simplifie la gestion des frais professionnels : photo des justificatifs, reconnaissance automatique, validation, export comptable, archivage à valeur probante , etc. L’objectif : faire gagner du temps aux entreprises tout en sécurisant leurs processus internes. Après une croissance progressive, l’équipe est passée de 20 personnes en 2021 à 230 aujourd’hui , portée par le succès produit et l’expansion internationale. Nous partageons un objectif commun : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des notes de frais et des factures fournisseurs. En 2021, N2JSoft a élargi son expertise avec Keeple , un logiciel RH dédié aux congés, absences et temps de travail (hors périmètre de ce poste). Quelques chiffres 230 collaborateurs , dont 50 dans l'équipe tech Notre site est basé à Montagnat (01) avec un format de télétravail hybride ou full remote. L’équipe tech Notre équipe est composée de développeurs/euses full stack expérimenté(e)s , réparti(e)s en squads : Notes de frais, Cartes de paiement pro, Invoices, Core… Chaque squad réunit : développeurs/euses, tech lead, team lead, product manager et testeur/euses QA. Stack et pratiques Front : Angular 16/21 Back : .NET 10 – C# Infra : AWS BDD : MSSQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB Architecture : monolithe modulaire Bonnes pratiques : tests unitaires, revues de code, pair programming, couverture Qodana, Microsoft Release Flow. Méthodo : Agile Scrum, sprints de 2 semaines (daily, weekly, rétro, planning). Le profil recherché Rattaché(e) à un(e) Team Lead dans l'une des squads produit, tu disposes : D'une formation en informatique Bac+3 minimum De 3 ans d’expérience en .NET / C# (web ou backend) De 2 ans d'expérience sur Angular et de bonnes connaissances front-end (HTML/CSS, TypeScript) D'une bonne maîtrise de SQL D'une expérience avec les technologies Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et Docker Et tu fais preuve : D' esprit d’équipe pour travailler dans un climat de confiance, d'entraide et de responsabilité partagée De curiosité et d'ouverture pour comprendre le besoin de nos utilisateurs et l'environnement technique De pragmatisme et rigueur pour produire un code fiable avec un impact maîtrisé. Les points d’attention : Il est crucial de bien comprendre le périmètre fonctionnel du produit pour réussir dans ce poste. Nous recherchons quelqu’un qui souhaite s’investir dans la durée et contribuer à la construction d’un projet pérenne, plutôt qu’à une mission ponctuelle. Les plus : Une croissance forte et continue (50% par an depuis 3 ans) dans une entreprise rentable Une structure claire et spécialisée avec une équipe tech solide et des squads bien identifiées Une stack moderne régulièrement mise à jour, avec des migrations planifiées et suivies Pas de micro management et une culture de travail basée sur la confiance et l’écoute La possibilité de faire du full-remote avec une semaine de présence par trimestre Processus de recrutement Préqualification avec nos recruteurs Test technique à réaliser en autonomie (7 jours de deadline) Entretien technique / code review avec notre équipe tech (1h) Entretien avec le CTO (40 min) A la fin du processus de recrutement, une rencontre plus informelle de 20 minutes peut être organisée afin de rencontrer tes futurs collègues. Télétravail : Environ 100 de nos collaborateurs travaillent en full remote , depuis différentes régions. Pour celles et ceux qui résident à proximité de nos locaux, une présence quotidienne est privilégiée (avec un jour de télétravail par semaine ). Les personnes situées à environ une heure de route viennent généralement deux jours par semaine sur site. Pour les collaborateurs en full remote , nous organisons une semaine de présence par trimestre , prise en charge par l’entreprise, afin de renforcer les liens avec l’équipe et de partager les temps forts de la vie interne. Ces semaines s’inscrivent dans notre rythme d’ événements trimestriels (ateliers, moments conviviaux, séminaires, etc.), qui participent à la cohésion et à la culture d’équipe. En résumé, nous adaptons le rythme de télétravail à la situation géographique de chacun , dans un esprit de flexibilité, de confiance et de collaboration . Rémunération et avantages 40–53k€ brut annuel en fonction de l’expérience/niveau technique CDI cadre – 37h/semaine Prime de vacances Chèques cadeaux, culture, rentrée scolaire Cours de musique sur site Événements d’équipe toute l’année N2JSOFT s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité hommes-femmes et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés. title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or UK Remote | 💰<a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-0.pdf"> Senior Engineer (L50)</a> £105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> | <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology">Technology</a> - Engineering  </p> <p><strong>About our Engineering Teams:</strong></p> <p>We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.</p> <p>These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.</p> <p>We contribute to <a href="https://github.com/monzo"><strong>open source software</strong></a> as much as possible. Our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology"><strong>blog</strong></a><strong> </strong>is a good place to learn even more about what we do!</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day   </strong></p> <p>This role is all about collaborating with your team to make a difference to your customers. As a backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside other disciplines like product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more! </p> <p>Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). They are: Core Banking, Business Banking, Wealth, Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Platform, Fincrime, Security & Expansion. All of our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront- from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.</p> <p>They’re all looking for additional Backend Engineers right now, we do a standard interview process across all our collectives and at the end we will find the best match for you based on your skills, experience, preferences and aligning with the business need! </p> <p>Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻</strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️</p> <p>Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.</p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency 🕣✨</p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p><strong>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product</li> <li>you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</li> <li>you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</li> <li>you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity</li> <li>you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software</li> <li>you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).</li> <li>you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing</li> </ul> <p>We're on the look out for L50 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-1.pdf">Engineering Progression Framework </a>- we will interview you across the whole frame work, so if you are not sure what level you are aiming for please chat to your recruiters! </p> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything thats listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</em></p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on: </strong></p> <p>We hire very technically agnostic so whilst we use the below technologies we do not expect prior knowledge, you will be fully supported in our organised onboarding to get up to speed in the below: </p> <ul> <li><a href="http://golang.org/"><strong>Go</strong></a> to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial <a href="https://tour.golang.org/welcome/1"><strong>here</strong></a>)</li> <li><a href="http://cassandra.apache.org/"><strong>Cassandra</strong></a> for most persistent data storage</li> <li><a href="http://kafka.apache.org/"><strong>Kafka</strong></a> for our asynchronous message queue</li> <li><a href="http://kubernetes.io/"><strong>Kubernetes</strong></a> and <a href="https://www.docker.com/"><strong>Docker</strong></a> to schedule and run our services </li> <li><a href="https://www.envoyproxy.io/"><strong>Envoy Proxy</strong></a> for RPC</li> <li><a href="http://aws.amazon.com/"><strong>AWS</strong></a> for most of our production infrastructure and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/"> <strong>GCP</strong></a> for most of our data infrastructure</li> <li>React for our public web apps and internal tools</li> <li>We also have physical datacenters with actual cables to connect to various third parties</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process:</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages: </p> <ol> <li>Initial Call </li> <li>Take home task or pair coding exercise </li> <li>Final interview: including a system design and a behavioural interview </li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. </p> <p>One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/2022/03/23/demystifying-the-backend-engineering-interview-process"><strong>here</strong></a>.<br><br><em>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. </em><u><em><span><a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo" target="_blank">You can read them here.</a></span></em></u></p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰 £105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here </strong></a></p> <p> </p> <p><em>We're usually always hiring for Backend Engineers, so there's no closing date for this job.</em></p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> <p>#LI-NB</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for Business & Financial Judgement: Demonstrated ability to connect operational queue dynamics directly to dollar exposure, hiring velocity, BPO costs, and SLA risk. Executive Communication: Superior strategic writing skills with a natural instinct to distil complex, multi-variable workforce analytics into scannable, 1-2 page decision memos. to streamline, automate and improve how we deliver compliance advice and manage conduct risk.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have significant be beneficial if you have:</p> <ul> <li>Knowledge or experience of cryptoassets, digital assets or stablecoins, including the regulatory perimeter and the developing UK regime.</li> <li>Experience of advising on telecommunications or other non-financial regulated products, particularly knowledge of the UK telecommunications framework and Ofcom’s General Conditions of Entitlement.</li> </ul> <p>🙌 We’re looking for a brilliant social strategist and storyteller to help us scale our next chapter: showing up less like a standard brand account and more like an authoritative, high-craft Media Publisher.</p> <p>Through witty, relatable, and deeply educational content, we’ve already proven that we can challenge what a bank looks like online. As our Social Content Manager, you’ll be the creative engine behind our feeds. You won't just follow internet culture; you’ll help us create it, turning complex financial concepts into scroll-stopping, uniquely Monzo content.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Team 💫</strong></p> <p>You’ll join a tight-knit, collaborative social team. We’re moving away from the old playbook to build a high-quality, always-on social ecosystem with partners at the top of their game, and we need someone to lead the charge. This role is a massive piece of the puzzle. You’ll have the creative autonomy to experiment, tear up the rulebook, and directly define how Monzo shows up across the internet.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Champion platform-native creativity:</strong> Bring a deep, nuanced understanding of social platforms, including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook and Threads. You'll help brief, guide, and refine their output to design and execute repeatable, episodic content formats that build long-term audience loyalty.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate cross-functionally:</strong> Work seamlessly across internal teams, partnering with Brand Designers, Copywriters, and the broader marketing org, to align social-first concepts with our overarching brand strategies and business goals.</li> <li><strong>Translate platform insights into action:</strong> Keep a pulse on performance metrics and platform trends. You’ll translate data and audience behavior into actionable creative insights, continuously refining your concepts to keep our brand at the cutting edge. You won’t be afraid to experiment and learn from the data.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You balance strategic partnerships with hands-on hustle.</strong> You’re completely comfortable collaborating with agency partners to bring big ideas to life, but you’re equally excited to roll up your sleeves and get stuck into the day-to-day execution.</li> <li><strong>You have a deep understanding of social platforms.</strong> You know how to hook an audience in the first two seconds, you understand algorithm behavior, and you have a portfolio of social-first content you’re incredibly proud of that shows your ability to translate concepts across channels.</li> <li><strong>You’re driven by commercial performance.</strong> You don’t just create for the sake of views or vanity metrics; you have a strong commercial instinct and a genuine interest in how creative storytelling drives real business growth.</li> <li><strong>You thrive in a lean, agile environment.</strong> You’re excited to be a key player in a tight-knit, in-house team where your impact is felt daily and collaboration is second nature. You know how to be funny and provocative without punching down or taking unnecessary risks with our brand reputation. </li> <li><strong>You have impeccable planning skills.</strong> You’ll have your finger on the pulse of money and wider culture to look at how we integrate trending conversations in to our brand world, tastefully and with meaningful value for our audience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This role may not be for you if...</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to slot into a fully fleshed-out system.</strong> We are still actively building, experimenting, and scaling our social playbook. If you need rigid, pre-established processes to succeed rather than the chance to help craft and design our systems from inception, this won’t be the right fit.</li> <li><strong>You shy away from high-production social.</strong> While we love quick, reactive, and native content, we also play in the big leagues. description: Who We Are Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. Continuous growth: Develop your technical and product expertise through ownership, learning, initiative, and constructive feedback. Collaborative culture: Work alongside passionate colleagues who value knowledge sharing, mutual support, diverse perspectives, and collective success. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. We're looking for someone with experience specifically in the Vulnerable Customer domain.</p> <p>We are changing how we manage our relationships with our outsourcing partners by driving more responsibility and accountability through our Monzo domain leaders. We need a brilliant Seniors Managers to join this new oversight team, reporting directly to the Directors within each business area. </p> <p>Partner management is moving right into the heart of our domains. You will be our eyes and ears on the ground, making sure our offshore outsource partners feel like a true extension of Monzo and not just an outsourced supplier. We ensure our partners are set up for success and deliver fantastic customer service.</p> <p><strong><br>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>You will act as the vital bridge between Monzo and our external partners to ensure they feel like a true extension of our team. You will drive both operational delivery and a brilliant customer experience. Working closely with our site leaders in South Africa, you will manage day to day service delivery while keeping a close eye on quality, customer satisfaction, and risk management. A key part of your role involves translating our strategic business goals into clear, actionable steps for the partner management team so they are fully equipped to succeed. You will support in domain forecasting and rolling out new processes to make sure they actually work on the floor. Ultimately, you will integrate our partner leaders into our regular performance reviews to foster a genuine one team mindset across the operation.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Leading a dedicated oversight team:</strong> You will directly manage a Supplier Operations Partner who wil focus on Operational Delivery like SLAs, schedule adherence, Customer Experience, quality, and fixing the root causes of repeat contacts.</li> <li><strong>Managing the partnership day to day:</strong> You will work directly with our outsourced partner Operations Managers to ensure the whole domain is delivering the service, customer satisfaction, quality and risk management we expect.</li> <li><strong>Acting as the translation layer:</strong> You will turn our strategic business goals into practical, actionable steps for the outsouring management team. You will make sure they are equipped to succeed, rather than just telling them when they miss the mark.</li> <li><strong>Tracking and managing performance:</strong> You will work alongside our partners to oversee all aspects of day to day service management, including handling risk events and stepping in to engage partners directly when performance drifts.</li> <li><strong>Forecasting and planning:</strong> Alongside WFM you will raise and approve forecast requests and manage the end to end domain forecasting process for our partners.</li> <li><strong>Owning change execution:</strong> You will handle the end to end definition and execution of change through our partners, ensuring any new processes or solutions are actually fit for purpose on the floor.</li> <li><strong>Integrating the teams:</strong> You will support the domain Director to embed Teleperformance leaders into our existing domain performance review meetings, fostering a one team mindset.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You have proven track record of working closely with or managing global offshore partners and can manage to a customer experience, not just a commercial contract.</li> <li>You are deeply analytical mindset with the ability to anchor decisions in rigorous data, translating complex metrics into robust business cases that secure senior stakeholder buy in.</li> <li>You have a proven track record of leading through others and  can influence, coach, and guide Managers who do not report directly to you.</li> <li>You are brilliant at translating complex business goals into simple steps for frontline teams.</li> <li>You zoom out when solving operational problems. Don’t just look at the operational team, always think about how your decisions impact the rest of the business.</li> </ul> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.<strong><em><br><br></em></strong></p> <p>#LI-REMOTE<strong> </strong>#LI-CB4</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
description: Our Security and IT team keeps the 360Learning platform secure, compliant and auditable for the 1,500 organisations that learn on it every day. As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer, your mission is to make our infrastructure secure by design, detectable by default, and provable at audit time. 360Learning runs its learning platform on Azure and Kubernetes, certified ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. Over the past two years the technical security workload has grown on every front: a larger and more regulated customer base sending their own scans and security assessments, a wider detection and response scope, more infrastructure to keep hardened and auditable, and a growing backlog of security engineering projects that never reach the top of the queue. We are creating this position to add real technical capacity on the infrastructure side of security, and to move part of our security posture from manual effort to automated guardrails. You will be the bridge between security and platform engineering: deep enough in infrastructure to fix things yourself, and close enough to security operations to know what to look for. “Ours is a small, senior team with a broad scope: information security, compliance, infrastructure governance and internal tooling, with dual audit accountability on ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. That means direct impact and no layers between you and the decision. Roughly half of this role is greenfield build work you will own end to end.” Guillaume Seigneuret, CISO and Hiring Coach. Within 1 month, you will: Complete our onboarding and learn how we work through our own platform and our Convexity culture Map our Azure and AKS environment, our detection and logging coverage, and our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 control scope with the CISO and the Security Engineer Meet the DevOps, platform engineering and IT teams you will work with daily Shadow alert triage and one customer security assessment end to end Within 3 months, you will: Be autonomous on our AKS and Azure environment and handle infrastructure related alerts end to end Have shipped at least one concrete hardening or automation improvement in production Own the infrastructure scope of vulnerability management, from triage to remediation follow up Within 6 months, you will: Have the honeypot live and producing high fidelity alerts Have measurably widened SIEM connector coverage, with documented log sources and retention Run infrastructure vulnerability remediation on a predictable cycle with SLA reporting Within 12 months, you will: Manage detection content as code, with reviewed and tested rules and documented runbooks Have largely automated audit evidence on the infrastructure scope Have eliminated long lived credentials on the critical paths, so engineering teams ship on secure defaults they did not have to think about The Skill Set: 5+ years in infrastructure, cloud or platform engineering with a strong security focus, or in security engineering with hands on infrastructure practice Production experience with Kubernetes: RBAC, network policies, admission controllers, secrets handling, workload identity, runtime security Solid cloud experience, ideally Azure. Strong AWS or Google Cloud experience with a genuine interest in converting works too Infrastructure as code: Terraform, GitOps workflows, CI/CD pipelines Scripting and automation: Python or Go, plus shell. Comfortable reading and writing code, and opening pull requests on repositories owned by other teams Log analysis and investigation: cloud audit logs, query languages, correlation across identity, network and application sources Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR). Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L What we offer: Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈 Benefits/Perks : Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent. Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠 Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion : We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝 Corporate Social Responsibility : Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter 🌎🌏🌍 Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L & find out more about the teams, product and processes https://bit.ly/42H1ggC 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆 Interview Process: Phone Screen with our Talent Acquisition Manager Discovery Meeting with our Head of Security Live exercise with our Head of Security and our Head of Devops: investigation of an incident scenario, or review of an insecure infrastructure configuration Clarification Meeting with the Security Engineer and a DevOps engineer Culture Fit Meeting with our VP of Engineering Offer! Who We Are 360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place. 360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA. Learning Includes Everyone. In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment. We want to learn from and with you! Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Manager, DC Commercial Diligence
description: Who We Are Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the worldâs largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company. Vultr Cares 100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans. 401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year 11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year $500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month Company paid Wellable subscription Join Vultr Vultr is seeking a Manager of DC Commercial Diligence to support commercial due diligence across our data center acquisition pipeline. This is a hands-on underwriting role: for every site Vultr pursues, whether an operator colocation lease, a powered shell, a lease-to-own structure, or a powered land purchase, you will work the data room directly, build out findings, and bring a well-supported point of view to the Senior Manager on whether the deal is what it claims to be. You will build fluency across power availability and energy commercial terms, counterparty and lease economics, and the deal model, and your work will directly inform the Go/No-Go recommendations and negotiating positions the Senior Manager brings to investment gates on transactions worth tens to hundreds of millions of dollars. Your job is to be constructively adversarial to every deal: the diligence function exists to find what the seller's materials do not say. Key Responsibilities Support commercial due diligence end to end for active acquisitions: review documents in the data room, maintain the findings register, and prepare evidence-based materials for investment gates alongside the Senior Manager Diligence power under guidance: interconnection queue position versus contracted capacity, utility and ESA terms, tariff structure, curtailment provisions, demand charge pass-throughs, and power-on forecast credibility, flagging where bankable capacity and marketing figures diverge Diligence counterparties: operator financial health and credit, guarantor structure, lease terms including minimum power obligations, escalations, expansion rights, termination provisions, and service level commitments Build and maintain components of the deal model: total development cost, fit-out and NRC comparisons, yield, tax and incentive assumptions, and sensitivity to power cost and ramp scenarios, under the Senior Manager's review Verify seller claims against primary sources: utility confirmations, interconnection studies, executed versus draft agreements, title and site control instruments Draft Go/No-Go packages, risk registers, and challenge questions for operators; run day-to-day RFI cycles through resolution Support the Senior Manager, Director, and Acquisitions Managers with diligence-derived data and analysis; do not carry deal negotiation Escalate findings transparently through the Senior Manager, including adverse findings that may be unwelcome to the deal team Coordinate with external counsel and consultants on legal, environmental, and specialty workstreams under the Senior Manager's direction Help pre-qualify pipeline sites toward proposal-ready status so sales never offers an unvetted site Apply and help refine repeatable diligence frameworks, checklists, and data room standards across deal types Track diligence performance metrics: cycle time per deal, findings volume and severity, and post-close issue rate Qualifications 3-6 years in data center, energy, or infrastructure transactions with hands-on exposure to due diligence: you have worked in data rooms and contributed to investment views, even if final sign-off sat with others Working familiarity with power markets: interconnection processes and queue mechanics, utility tariffs, energy services agreements, and power purchase agreement structures as applied to data centers Solid understanding of data center lease structures, operator economics, and mission-critical delivery commitments Strong financial modeling ability in Excel: comfortable building and maintaining components of a development cost, returns, and scenario model Demonstrated attention to detail in finding discrepancies in deal materials: capacity claims that did not hold, unexecuted agreements presented as commitments, terms with hidden exposure Able to synthesize a large document set into clear, evidence-cited findings for review by senior stakeholders Comfortable managing multiple concurrent diligences in a fast-moving deal environment, with guidance from the Senior Manager Bachelor's degree required; coursework or certification in finance, engineering, or energy valued Preferred Experience Infrastructure private equity, investment banking, or project finance deal teams; hyperscaler energy or site acquisition; IPP or utility origination; data center operator corporate development Exposure to behind-the-meter generation and natural gas supply arrangements (firm transport, MDCQ, balancing) Familiarity with the GPU/AI infrastructure ecosystem and hyperscale construction processes Compensation $110,000-$135,000 Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h1><strong>An Overview of this role</strong></h1> <p>As a Senior Data Scientist at GitLab on the Enterprise Analytics team, you’ll be a trusted analytical partner to Sales, Revenue Operations, and Finance, helping define how we measure go-to-market performance and where we invest to grow. This is a strategic and hands-on role. You’ll apply statistical, experimentation, and machine learning methods to forecast outcomes, explain what drives activation, conversion, expansion, and retention, and size opportunities. maintain and advocate for these standards through code review</li> <li>Help grow the Data Science function by defining and socializing best practices within a DataOps and MLOps data ecosystem</li> </ul> <h1><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h1> <ul> <li>5+ years of professional experience in GTM analytics, data science, or a similar technical role</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear, measurable questions and communicate technical concepts effectively to non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience with experimentation and causal inference (A/B testing, power analysis, quasi-experimental methods) and with statistical and machine learning methods such as regression, classification, clustering, and survival analysis</li> <li>Deep, hands-on understanding of SQL in cloud data warehouses (like Snowflake SQL), including working with product usage and event data, and in business intelligence tools (Looker, Tableau, Hex, or similar)</li> <li>Professional experience using Python for statistical modeling, machine learning, and production data science. With hands-on experience in pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Jupyter, and related libraries such as LightGBM and XGBoost</li> <li>Hands-on experience building agentic workflows with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, OpenCode, or similar), including connecting agents to the right context, tools, and platforms such as MLflow, and evaluating their output for accuracy and reliability.</li> <li>Practical understanding of the ML lifecycle in production: CI/CD for models, versioning, automated retraining, drift/performance monitoring, and rollback</li> <li>Experience working in a B2B company working with motions and metrics, including Consumption, CRR, ARR, and Churn & Contraction</li> <li>Track record of building and shipping 2 or more production models or data products (e.g., propensity, PQL scoring, churn, or expansion models) and of delivering 4 or more analyses or experiments that influenced product or go-to-market decisions</li> <li>Self-motivated and self-managing, with strong organizational skills</li> <li>Ability to use GitLab and to thrive in a fully remote organization</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the Team</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong>The Enterprise Analytics team builds the trusted data products and insights behind GitLab’s company-wide sales, revenue, and finance reporting. We work across the business on metrics including First Orders, pipeline, CRR, ARR, and other key indicators, helping leaders make informed decisions and teams understand how their work contributes to GitLab’s growth.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. title: VP of Brand and Communications
description: About Oscilar Oscilar is building the Agentic Risk Platformâ¢ for banks and fintechs , reimagining how financial institutions manage fraud, credit risk, compliance and onboarding in the AI era. Our platform brings decisioning, data and AI agents together in one system, so risk teams can make better decisions in real time and automate increasingly complex work. Agent Hub gives them 30+ specialized AI agents across fraud, AML, credit, onboarding, sanctions and disputes. Oscilar is trusted by 100+ fintechs and financial institutions , including SoFi, MoneyGram and Nuvei, and makes tens of billions of risk decisions a year. ARR has grown 15x in the last 2 years . Oscilar was founded by Neha Narkhede , co-creator of Apache Kafka and co-founder of Confluent, which went public at a valuation of about $10 billion and later agreed to be acquired by IBM for $11 billion. The Role We're hiring our first VP of Brand and Communications to lead Brand, PR and Communications and make Oscilar the defining name in agentic risk. You'll own how Oscilar shows up in the market: the story we tell, the voice we tell it in, and where it gets heard. That means directing our PR to land Oscilar in Tier 1 publications and keep a steady drumbeat of coverage around every launch and milestone; defining a brand voice and guidelines that make us instantly recognizable as the agentic risk platform; launching brand campaigns that get financial services leaders talking; and turning our founder's industry profile into reach with the buyers we sell to. This is a player-coach role. You'll set the strategy for brand, PR and comms, and personally get the first versions of the most important work out the door. You'll lead our PR and comms lead, our creative lead and our PR agencies from day one, hire your first team member soon after joining, and build the team as results come in. You'll also build the playbook for an AI-native brand function, using agents and automation so a small team can do far more than its size suggests. You'll report to Tomas Lobo, VP of Marketing and Growth , and work closely with our CEO and executive team, Product Marketing, Growth, Events and Design. This is a high-ownership role with direct impact on Oscilar's growth and reputation. What You'll Own Brand Strategy & Category Leadership Own Oscilar's brand strategy end to end, and make Oscilar the defining name in agentic risk. Work with our founders to sharpen the agentic risk narrative, and turn it into a point of view the market repeats back to us. Turn executive alignment into a cohesive brand voice and brand guidelines, and make sure the brand shows up consistently across the website, sales, content, social and events. Evolve the brand as the company grows: new products, new markets and new audiences. Own the brand budget and investment plan, and decide where each dollar builds the most awareness and trust. Make sure Oscilar shows up in AI search and LLM answers, not just traditional search and media. PR & Communications Set the bar for what great PR looks like, and direct our agencies (including Highwire) to get there. Land Oscilar's story in Tier 1 publications such as Fortune and the Wall Street Journal. Build a steady drumbeat of earned media around product launches, customer stories, company milestones and timely news. Build lasting relationships with the media, analysts and industry voices that shape our market. Run PR as the long game it is, while making sure Oscilar shows up in today's conversations. Own crisis communications readiness and the corporate narrative around major company moments. Partner with People on our employer brand, so the story we tell the market also attracts great talent. Social Strategy Own Oscilar's social strategy across founder-led, executive-led, employee-led and company channels. Make each channel amplify the others, so a single story travels from Neha to our executives, our employees and the company page. Build an employee advocacy program that turns our team into a distribution channel. Measure social by reach and engagement with the buyers we sell to, not vanity metrics. Founder & Executive Presence Manage Neha's presence across social media, video, media, podcasts and events, building on her 50K followers and her standing in the industry. Own her roadmap of speaking, media and social moments, so she shows up in the right places at the right time. Build the platforms that make Neha and our executives and experts the voices people seek out on AI, fraud, credit and compliance. Content & Thought Leadership Set the long-term content strategy that builds Oscilar's authority in AI and risk: original research, data assets, signature franchises and executive points of view. Bring Product Marketing, PR and content together around one shared plan, so every launch and campaign tells part of the same story. Build content that compounds over time and becomes the reference point for our industry. Brand Campaigns & Programs Launch fast, high-ROI brand campaigns alongside long-term programs. Our first is the Agents of Risk awards program. Run several bets in parallel, set clear goals for each, measure results, and decide quickly what to scale or stop. Turn what works into flagship programs, partnerships and experiences that become recognized across financial services. Team & AI-Native Operations Lead and grow our PR and comms lead, our creative lead and our agency partners from day one. Build the Brand, PR and Communications team over time, adding your first hire soon after joining and growing the function as results come in. Build an AI-native function: automate brand, PR and social workstreams with agents so a small team can do far more. Define the function's priorities, operating rhythm and how we measure brand impact. What Success Looks Like First 90 days: You've set the brand and PR strategy, are directing our agencies with a clear point of view, and have early wins on the board: earned media around our launches, a brand voice the company has adopted, and the first brand campaigns live and measured. First year: Oscilar is recognized as the defining name in agentic risk. We have Tier 1 coverage and a steady drumbeat of earned media, a social presence that reaches the buyers we sell to across founder, executive, employee and company channels, and flagship programs the industry looks forward to. Long term: You've built a high-performing, AI-native Brand, PR and Communications team, and brand has become one of Oscilar's biggest competitive advantages. What We're Looking For 10+ years in brand, PR and communications, including leading brand and PR or comms at VP or Head-of level at a successful, sales-led B2B SaaS company. Deep PR judgment. You've directed agencies to Tier 1 coverage and know what great looks like. You've built a brand voice and guidelines that teams actually used, and you can take a messy draft and make it sharp. You've run fast, measurable brand campaigns alongside long-term programs. You're a hands-on player-coach: proactive, responsive, and quick to ship rather than theorize. You're AI-native and have automated real marketing work with AI tools or agents. You've managed experienced people and agencies, and aligned teams such as PMM and content on one plan. You've owned a brand budget and managed creative teams and agencies across PR, design and video. Clear, concise communication and strong creative instincts. Bonus Experience Selling to fintech, financial services, payments, identity, security or other risk and trust buyers. Running a founder-led social program, especially for a technical founder. Launching an awards program or other industry-recognition campaign. Building a brand or comms function from scratch, or leading through a major moment such as an IPO or large announcement. Why This Role Is Unique Build from scratch, without the typical startup risk. You'll build Oscilar's brand function from the ground up at a company that already has product-market fit and has grown ARR 15x in 2 years. A proven, second-time founder. Work directly with Neha Narkhede, who co-created Apache Kafka and co-founded Confluent, taking it to a roughly $10 billion IPO and an $11 billion acquisition agreement with IBM. A manager who has done this before. Tomas Lobo helped build Samsara from $1M to close to $500M in ARR in about 5 years. A category to name. Help define agentic risk, a new category at the intersection of AI, risk and financial infrastructure. Room to build. A VP title, a seat with the founders, a PR partner already in place, and room to hire and build your team. Benefits Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages, including a 401k plan. Flexibility: Remote-first culture. Health: 100% employer-covered comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance with a top-tier plan for you and your dependents. (US) Balance: Unlimited PTO policy. Culture: Family-friendly environment; regular team events and offsites. Development: Unparalleled learning and professional development opportunities. Impact: Help make the internet safer by protecting online transactions and building the infrastructure powering the future of financial risk. description: The team at Klim is building the operating system for regenerative agriculture. We help farms restore their soil - and turn that into real, measurable business value for the food companies, banks and insurers who depend on it. We’re a Berlin-based agritech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and ADM to build supply chain resilience through regenerative agriculture. Since 2020, we’ve supported +4,000 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares. Join our incredible team of 80+ dedicated people across Germany, the UK, Poland and Czechia to help build a more sustainable, resilient food system and drive real climate impact. Your mission: Own the design experience of Klim end to end, and build the AI-augmented design process that lets a small design team and product managers ship coherent, high-quality work at scale. You'll do the hardest design work yourself and raise the level of everyone who designs around you. This means it is a player/coach role with 60% hands-on design and 40% building the system and process around you. What you'll do Product experience: Own the end-to-end experience across farmer and partner journeys, from onboarding through assessment, planning and improvement, verification and reporting and paymnet, shaping journeys and value moments with product managers, not only interfaces. Design the most complex and brand-critical work, from wireframes and flows to polished, high-fidelity interaction and visual design. Cut farmer effort, with a focus on "enter once, used everywhere" data capture, simpler onboarding and self-serve help. Run continuous research, usability testing and A/B tests with farmers and partners, and track experience metrics (activation, task completion, time-to-value, satisfaction) with product and analytics. AI-augmented design process: Own and deliver Klim's AI-augmented design model maintaining highest quality while enabling others to deliver simpler design needs under your guidance Own the canonical design system with engineering: components and page templates, with code as the source of truth and Figma kept in sync. Define the handoff contract and the automated and human coherence checks, using AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code, Claude Design, Figma, Storybook) and rules AI tools can follow. Measure and improve the process: self-serve share, first-pass coherence, review time, engineering rework and ticket-to-design lead time. Engineering efficiency and quality: Partner with engineering leads to simplify and standardise how UI is built, so new features reuse proven patterns instead of starting from scratch. Reduce design-related rework by making requirements, states and edge cases explicit before build. Govern the intake of new patterns and log any exceptions, so the system grows deliberately rather than drifting. Coach: Enable product managers to design simpler elements well within the system through templates, patterns, content rules and review. Build design rituals (critique, design reviews, a shared quality bar) and make the case for design decisions with evidence across product, engineering and commercial teams. What you bring: 5+ years in product design, including senior or lead roles owning complex B2B or data-heavy products end to end. Exceptional interaction and visual design craft, with mastery of Figma. You'll personally deliver the most complex and brand-critical work. A portfolio that shows product-level impact (engagement, adoption, satisfaction), not only interface quality. Proven ability to improve engagement and strong plus for experience running A/B tests and product experiments and strong research skills. Proven experience building and running a design system with engineering, ideally in React and Storybook, with tokens and components treated as code. Hands-on use of AI tools in design and delivery (e.g. Claude, Figma AI or similar), and a clear view of where they help and where they don't. A track record of designing processes others adopt, coaching designers and enabling non-designers, while still doing strong hands-on work. Clear communication with farmers, engineers and executives alike. Fluent English. Nice to have: German, to speak directly with farmers. Experience in agriculture, climate, sustainability or other multi-sided platforms. Experience with multi-language products and content design. Why join Klim Opportunity: Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company. Impact: Your work helps farmers move to regenerative practice and helps companies cut supply-chain emissions. Ownership: you'll set how design works at Klim, with direct access to leadership and a clear influence on the product roadmap. Competitive package: competitive salary and participation in our VSIP program. Flexible work: At Klim, we foster a flexible, hybrid work approach and facilitate temporary remote work (within the EU). It is advantageous for this role if you live in Berlin or can be present in our office regularly. Additional benefits : We offer a subsidy for a membership in Urban Sports Club or the Deutschlandticket (if based in Germany), a company pension scheme, plus team lunches and regular team events. At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all. description: Title: Systems and Digital Solutions Intern Type of contract: Paid internship Contract duration: 6 months Work time: Full-time (40 hours per week) or part-time Reporting to: Systems and Digital Solutions Coordinator Technical guidance: BI and Systems Officer Location: Remote (home-based outside Switzerland) Start date: January 2027 Application deadline: 10/12/2026 Background The Global Survivors Fund (GSF) was launched in October 2019 by Dr Denis Mukwege and Nadia Murad, 2018 Nobel Peace Prize laureates. Other Requirements Good written and spoken English; French or another GSF working language is an asset. Analytical, organised and service-oriented approach, with attention to detail and confidentiality; Ability to learn quickly, document work clearly and escalate issues appropriately; Ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural and predominantly remote environment; Commitment to GSF’s survivor-centred values, safeguarding, inclusion, accountability and responsible use of data and technology. title: Engineering Manager, Payments (all genders)
description: About us Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com . We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond. The opportunity We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Payments engineering team within the E-commerce department. Payments takes, refunds and reconciles customer money across our white-label booking sites, subscriptions and in-person sales points, integrating with providers such as Adyen, PayPal and Checkout.com. Correctness, reliability and security are non-negotiable. You might lead more than one team from the start, and as the department grows, the scope of this role can expand to other engineering areas. We need someone with real payments depth who also wants to grow as a multi-team leader. We invest in AI-assisted development, from shared agent skills to AI-driven SDLC tooling, and we expect our leaders to shape how their teams work with it. What you will do: Lead several engineering teams, working through tech leads to set direction, priorities and delivery across them. Hire, coach and grow senior engineers and future leaders. Own performance, career development and team structure as the area scales. Own the health of our payment platform: reliability, idempotency, provider failover, webhook handling and incident response. Shape the roadmap with Product, balancing new payment methods and markets against platform investment, cost and provider fees. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An Overview of this Role</strong></h2> <p>As an Enterprise Application Developer at GitLab, you'll build and maintain the custom applications and internal platforms that GitLab Support teams rely on to do their best work. R&D.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the full platform lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing optimization.</li> <li>Design, build, test, and maintain automated workflows, request forms, routing logic, approvals, SLAs, queues, and integrations across enterprise teams.</li> <li>Develop and manage integrations with platforms including Snowflake, Claude, Salesforce, Slack, GitLab, Zendesk, and internal application catalogs.</li> <li>Enable automated ticket creation, intelligent routing, provisioning, offboarding, and employee lifecycle processes.</li> <li>Partner with cross-functional stakeholders, application owners, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.</li> <li>Establish and maintain standards for security, compliance, auditability, documentation, and operational reliability.</li> <li>Lead platform modernization and automation initiatives by identifying opportunities to replace manual processes, improve self-service, and increase operational efficiency.</li> <li>Define governance practices and reusable standards for enterprise workflows, integrations, and support operations.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experienced Ruby developer with strong knowledge of GitLab, Zendesk, and Linux environments.</li> <li>Proven ability to translate technical solutions into practical, supportable operating processes—and to translate operational needs into effective technical designs.</li> <li>Advanced expertise in automation, workflow design, systems integration, and platform governance.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, IT or equivalent professional experience is required.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to design reliable solutions across complex technical and organizational environments.</li> <li>Experience working on projects with multiple stakeholders and knowledge of Change Management best practices is a plus.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills — technical writing experience a plus</li> <li>Well-organized, excellent work ethic, attention to detail, and self-starting</li> <li>Experience troubleshooting and resolving urgent, high-visibility technical problems</li> <li>Excellent problem solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p>The work is full-stack, fast, and pragmatic. You'll partner with business stakeholders to understand what they actually need, turn that into working software quickly, and own it once it's live.
