title: Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring a <strong>Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer</strong> to our Information Systems (IS) team. <span style="font-weight: 400;">This role is an opportunity for an “automation-first” technologist</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> with a </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products.  <span style="font-weight: 400;">If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.</span><br></span></p> <h2>Job Summary</h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical’s IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As an SRE & Gitops engineer you’ll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical’s leading products for software operation automation.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they’re based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">You’ll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical’s customers and the Ubuntu Community.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Location</strong>: This role is available remotely in any timezone.</span></p> <h2>As a Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer engineer you will</h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Develop new features and improve the resilience and scalability of the existing cloud and container portfolio at Canonical</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical’s core services, networks, and infrastructure</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Collaborate with development teams to design service architecture, documentation, playbooks, policies and operational procedures</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and ‘doing work together’</span></span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Carry final responsibility for time-critical escalations</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">What we are looking for in you</span></h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">A deep experience of, and knowledge to define operations in code, using version control, peer review and CI/CD to roll out changes both to applications and infrastructure</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Strong modern engineering background (peer-review, unit testing, SCM, CI/CD, Agile)</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Python software development experience, with large projects</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to Databases</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Motivated and able to troubleshoot from kernel to web, and willing to ask others when appropriate</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">A willingness to be flexible and able to learn new things quickly</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Be inspired by the needs of fast-changing environments</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Happy to work within distributed teams</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Be passionate and familiarized about open-source, especially Ubuntu or Debian</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br></span></li> </ul> <h1>About Canonical</h1> <p>Canonical is a pioneering title: Webdesigner-/Entwickler – WordPress & AI (m/w/d)
description: Web Developer – WordPress & AI (m/w/d) Du denkst digital, liebst Technologie und findest, dass KI erst der Anfang ist? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen. Wir sind ANY Marketing – eine junge, dynamische Digitalagentur und Teil der The Radio Group. Während andere Radio machen, machen wir Radio und denken digital weiter. Wir entwickeln moderne Websites, individuelle Softwarelösungen, eigene Tools und KI-gestützte Anwendungen. Dabei verbinden wir Kreativität, Technologie und künstliche Intelligenz mit der Reichweite und den Möglichkeiten eines Medienunternehmens. Unser Alltag? Alles außer Standard. Heute eine Website für den Bäcker um die Ecke, morgen ein digitales Projekt für einen Großkonzern und übermorgen vielleicht eine eigene Softwarelösung, die es so noch gar nicht gibt. Dafür suchen wir dich! Was dich bei uns erwartet Du konzipierst und entwickelst moderne, individuelle Websites auf Basis von WordPress und Breakdance. Du entwickelst eigene WordPress-Plugins, Schnittstellen und individuelle Funktionalitäten. Du nutzt KI-Tools aktiv in deinem Entwicklungsalltag und entdeckst neue Möglichkeiten, Prozesse intelligenter und effizienter zu gestalten. Du begleitest digitale Kundenprojekte von der ersten Idee bis zum Go-live. Du arbeitest an unseren eigenen digitalen Produkten, Plattformen und innovativen Anwendungen mit. Du stehst im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kunden, verstehst ihre Anforderungen und entwickelst passende Lösungen. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und probierst neue Technologien aus. Was du mitbringen solltest Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrung mit WordPress – und zwar über die reine Inhaltspflege hinaus. HTML, CSS, JavaScript und PHP sind für dich keine Fremdwörter. Du hast erste Erfahrungen mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung gesammelt, beispielsweise mit Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT oder vergleichbaren Tools. Du hast ein Gespür für moderne Websites, gutes Design, Performance und Benutzerfreundlichkeit. Du arbeitest eigenständig, lösungsorientiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung. Du bist kommunikativ und hast keine Scheu vor dem direkten Kundenkontakt. Du bist neugierig auf neue Technologien und hast Lust, dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Nice to have, aber kein Muss: Erfahrung mit Breakdance oder vergleichbaren modernen WordPress-Buildern Erfahrung in der Entwicklung eigener WordPress-Plugins Kenntnisse in Next.js, React oder anderen modernen Webtechnologien Erfahrung mit APIs, Automatisierungen und KI-Agenten Kenntnisse in Git, Hosting und Deployment Du musst nicht alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du Lust hast, Neues zu lernen, Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und gemeinsam mit uns etwas aufzubauen. Was wir dir bieten KI-first statt KI irgendwann: Bei uns ist künstliche Intelligenz kein Zukunftsthema, sondern gelebter Arbeitsalltag. Abwechslung garantiert: Spannende Projekte vom lokalen Handwerksbetrieb bis zum Großkonzern. Homeoffice: Flexibles Arbeiten, das zu deinem Alltag passt. Kurze Entscheidungswege: Weniger Bürokratie, mehr Umsetzung. Echte Kundennähe: Du erlebst unmittelbar, welchen Unterschied deine Arbeit macht. Raum für deine Ideen: Wir wollen nicht nur, dass du Aufgaben abarbeitest, sondern dass du mitgestaltest. Moderne Technologien: Die Möglichkeit, neue Tools, Frameworks und KI-Anwendungen auszuprobieren und produktiv einzusetzen. Ein außergewöhnliches Arbeitsumfeld: Als Teil der The Radio Group arbeitest du mitten in der Medienwelt – zwischen Radiostudios, kreativen Köpfen, digitalen Innovationen und spannenden Persönlichkeiten. Ein Team auf Augenhöhe: Offener Austausch, gemeinsames Lernen und Spaß an dem, was wir tun. Perspektive: Gestalte mit uns den wachsenden digitalen Geschäftsbereich einer Mediengruppe aktiv mit. Dein Lebenslauf ist nicht dein Code. Ob du studiert hast, eine Ausbildung abgeschlossen hast oder dir das Entwickeln selbst beigebracht hast, ist für uns zweitrangig. Entscheidend ist, was du kannst, wie du denkst und wohin du dich entwickeln möchtest. Zeig uns gerne, woran du bereits gearbeitet hast, welche Projekte dich begeistern oder wie du KI in deinem Alltag einsetzt. Wir wollen Menschen kennenlernen, keine perfekten Bewerbungsunterlagen. Let's build something great. Du hast Lust, gemeinsam mit uns die digitale Zukunft eines Medienunternehmens zu gestalten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! ANY Marketing GmbH Ein Unternehmen der The Radio Group www.any-marketing.de Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Tools Engineer
description: Companion Group is a AAA co-development gaming studio with a globally distributed and fully remote setup, renowned for its adeptness in overcoming the most intricate challenges in multiplayer game development. Our reputation precedes us as an excellent choice for clients aspiring to elevate their latest multiplayer titles, enabling scalability in player numbers, maximising player density, and crafting immersive gameplay experiences. Embedded seamlessly within a client's in-house team, we collaborate harmoniously to turn dreams into reality. Our portfolio boasts groundbreaking games developed in collaboration with major studios worldwide. As a fully remote studio with colleagues across the globe, we value and emphasise clear, continuous, and transparent communication as highly as technical skills. As our Senior Tools Engineer , you will play a key role in building a log monitoring and coordination system designed to work with Unreal Engine, process event data, and ultimately provide robust, scalable insights into gameplay sessions. If you're comfortable in Linux environments, have backend experience, and are excited about working on foundational tools that interface with game systems, we want to hear from you! Responsibilities: Lead the development of internal tools that run on Linux-based environments. Help define and standardize development workflows and best practices in Linux for the team. Build and maintain back-end systems that ingest, process, and report on gameplay session data. Collaborate with game teams to integrate tools with Unreal Engine — including reading, managing, and altering log output and server-side controls. Design tooling interfaces that receive commands, push updates, and generate actionable reports. Required Skills: Strong proficiency with Linux environments, especially in development and deployment contexts. Experience with C# & C++. Solid understanding of backend engineering principles — including system design, service communication, and data pipelines. Working knowledge of Unreal Engine, particularly in relation to logging, runtime controls, and server communication. Ability to understand complex event graphs and gameplay state data structures. Clear, proactive communication skills and a collaborative mindset. Rewards: Competitive salary ranging from £50,000 to £70,000 Per Annum Embark on a clearly defined career ladder, enabling you to progress in responsibilities and be rewarded accordingly. Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote role, collaborating with top game developers from around the world. Join forces with industry leaders who will inspire and guide you on your path to success. title: 3D Concept & Visualization Artist (m/f/d) (Freelance / Working Student)
description: About Dufour Dufour provides sovereign, automated aerial logistics capabilities. Working closely with our communications team, you will visualize our upcoming aircraft platforms in real-world mission scenarios – while providing clean base renders that enable our team to generate fast variations using AI tools. What You Will Do Aircraft & Scenario Renderings : Create photorealistic and concept renderings of our new aircraft platforms operating across diverse environments and mission scenarios. 3D Modeling & Scene Setup : Prepare, optimize, and texture existing CAD models, or build complementary concept assets, environments, and lighting setups from scratch. Background : Open to everyone with a strong portfolio – ideal as a flexible side job for design students as well as independent freelancers. What We Oﬀer High-Visibility Impact : Shape the visual identity of brand-new aircraft platforms and critical defence-logistics systems. Uncomplicated Collaboration : Direct, fast feedback loops with a small, dedicated team – no bureaucratic overhead. Flexibility : Fully remote setup with flexible working hours that fit easily around your studies or other freelance projects. Fair Compensation : Competitive hourly rate or project-based flat fee. title: Revenue Operations Manager
description: <p>Canonical has opened management positions for exceptional Revenue Operations leaders to grow our global direct, alliance, channel, partner and online sales. Our Revenue Operations teams analyse and drive interventions to maximise net customer retention, and lead robust, repeatable processes to plan, manage and deliver revenue.</p> <p>As a Revenue Operations Manager you will partner with Canonical’s executive team across sales, business development, customer success, marketing, product management, commercial systems, delivery, finance and legal and provide a focal point to drive improvements. This position requires an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to drive process and system improvement.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: This role can be held remotely in all time zones.</p> <h2><strong>What your day will look like</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Deliver precise, scalable revenue operations for business through direct, indirect or online channels </li> <li>Develop and lead a team of revenue operations analysts in driving processes and providing daily operational support and enablement to sales teams and partners</li> <li>Drive Sales Engagement, Training/Enablement/Data Enrichment, Customer Relationship Management, Configure Price Quote, Analytics and Commissions</li> <li>Instrument, measure and improve processes across the entire revenue operations spectrum</li> <li>Deliver metrics and reporting to monitor and improve revenue operations effectiveness, including new leads, pipeline, velocity, sales productivity and renewals.  Use this data to drive insight, manage territories and channels, improve productivity, and agree and implement actionable change with executive management through regular sales and business reviews.</li> <li>Oversee our sales technology and processes, driving automation and process improvements and partnering with our commercial systems engineering team to continuously improve business systems and integration</li> <li>Lead the introduction of new products, pricing, packaging and bundling through systems that are easy for sales and partners to navigate and quote</li> <li>Drive data quality, through order processing, new hire training, process documentation, reporting and data cleansing </li> <li>Lead and enhance our commercial review process for evaluating and steering sales and alliance opportunities </li> <li>Own the commission plan and lead the process for setting goals, evaluating and paying against that plan</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in a related field, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path</li> <li>Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations</li> <li>Experience operating in a senior leadership role, driving effectiveness of direct, channel and alliance partnerships, ideally within a similar technology subscription-based business</li> <li>Track record of providing insight through robust technology platforms, data, analytics, compensation systems and processes to deliver excellent revenue operations</li> <li>Deep understanding of working in a global, multicultural organisation including managing a team of direct reports remotely in different time zones</li> <li>A thoughtful systematic approach, skill in measuring, identifying and delivering systems and processes that ensure repeatable, scalable outcomes</li> <li>Comfort with commercial pressure, and the ability to put revenue teams under appropriate performance pressure </li> <li>Organisational skills and the ability to interact and work with stakeholders within all levels of the organisation </li> <li>Communication and negotiation skills to achieve buy-in to priorities from key stakeholders</li> <li>Fluent in business English (written and spoken)</li> <li>Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

description: Who We Are Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. Lead cross-functional internal initiatives that improve how Vultr serves its customers, from planning through to a measurable outcome. Qualifications 10+ years of program or project management experience, including at least 5 years managing customer-facing delivery of large, complex technology programs in cloud, data center, HPC, AI or telecommunications. Proven ability to lead through influence across engineering, operations and commercial teams you don't manage. Executive presence, including experience running steering committees and holding difficult conversations with senior customer stakeholders. Solid grasp of infrastructure delivery (data centers, networking, servers and GPUs, storage), enough to ask engineers the right questions and judge the answers. Sound judgment under pressure, with a habit of raising risks early and bringing options rather than waiting for problems to escalate. Experience moving customers from project delivery into ongoing operations and support. Clear, concise written and verbal communication, from detailed working sessions to executive summaries. Proficiency with Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence and Salesforce, or similar program management, collaboration and CRM tools. Ability to travel up to 25% to customer sites and data centers. Flexibility to work extended hours, including some weekends, around major customer launches and across customer time zones. title: Senior Energy Markets Analyst, PJM
description: Voltus runs demand response programs across North American wholesale markets and utilities. As the Senior Energy Markets Analyst for PJM, you will own our PJM utility programs end to end. You will run one established utility program and help launch a second, newer one. You will also support Product and Partnerships in sizing and designing the next set of PJM utility programs, where much of our future revenue and margin sits. This is a high-autonomy role. You will manage your own work, with your manager setting priorities and reviewing results rather than directing day-to-day tasks. For each program you own, you will be the go-to expert inside Voltus and the main contact for the utility. What you will do Run our PJM utility programs end to end: registrations, nominations, dispatch, performance calculations and settlements. Help launch a new program and identify the next ones with Product and Partnerships. Advise Product and Partnerships on program design, opportunity sizing and utility proposals. You will not draft formal regulatory filings. Explain program rules in plain language to Sales, customers and Dispatch Ops, and write to utilities and PJM on registration and settlement issues. Support PJM - ELRP (Load Management) registrations starting in 2028. Guide and review the work of co-op and junior analysts. This role has no direct reports. What success looks like Within 60 days, you know the established program well enough to run it without the team's involvement. Registrations, nominations, tests, events and quarterly settlements are on time and accurate, and your manager reviews rather than does. New program registrations are submitted on time with no missed deadlines, and enrolled MW is at or near target. Baseline and performance methodology is agreed with Engineering and Product before the first dispatch. A written playbook for the new program exists that someone else could pick up. Product, Partnerships, Dispatch Ops and utility contacts come to you directly. Your analysis has informed a program design discussion with Product and Partnerships. What you bring Required 3 to 5 years of hands-on energy markets experience in demand response or a closely related area (registrations, performance calculations, settlements), in any ISO or utility program. Advanced Excel or Google Sheets: trackers, baseline-versus-metered-load calculations, and settlement reconciliations that others can audit. Basic SQL: read-only queries with joins, aggregations and filters to pull site, interval and dispatch data. Basic Python, with familiarity with Pandas, to process interval data across many sites and automate repetitive registration and settlement prep. Clear written communication, including plain-language explanations of program rules and professional correspondence with utilities and ISOs. Ownership: you make judgment calls on ambiguous program rules, know when to escalate, and build process where none exists. Availability during core Eastern hours and during test and event windows. PJM, the utilities and all program deadlines run on Eastern time. Preferred PJM experience, in this order of relevance: DR programs (ELRP, utility DR programs in PJM states); settlements and performance calculations; capacity market basics (PLCs, nominations, delivery year calendar); wholesale market operations. Strong DR candidates from ERCOT, NYISO or MISO are encouraged to apply.Â Please note that at this time, we do not sponsor visas or transfers for new hires. Voltus teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location (in the US or Canada, unless otherwise indicated on the role description). Additionally, while Voltus is an all-remote workplace, we have limitations on where employees are able to work for regulatory and security reasons. We expect that Voltans are working primarily from their home country. Working while traveling to other countries must be approved as per our Global Remote Travel Policy. At Voltus, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer because we recognize that a diverse organization begins with a diverse candidate pool. title: Senior Threat Research Engineer, Security Factory: Threat Research
location: Remote, Israel; Remote, Poland; Remote, United Kingdom
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a senior researcher in GitLab's Threat Research group, you'll turn emerging security threats into protection for GitLab customers. You'll lead your own research projects, taking ideas from the first question to a working proof of concept, deploying it, and analyzing the results. You'll also keep the detection systems you build running in production.</p> <p>Artificial intelligence (AI) is central to how we work. We build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection, and use AI tools every day to move faster. This is a full-stack research role: you'll combine an adversarial mindset with the software engineering skills to build and operate the systems behind your work.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead your own research projects, from the first idea to the published result.</li> <li>Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.</li> <li>Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.</li> <li>Analyze supply chain incidents and events.</li> <li>Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.</li> <li>Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.</li> <li>Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.</li> <li>Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with published findings such as Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) records, responsible disclosures, blog posts, or talks.</li> <li>Experience researching AI agents, large language model (LLM) applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and using AI in real work through LLM application programming interfaces (APIs) or agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or agent software development kits (SDKs).</li> <li>The ability to build systems and assess how to break them, with strong Go or Python skills and practices including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and maintainable code.</li> <li>Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.</li> <li>An understanding of package ecosystems and supply chain attacks, informed by current security and AI industry trends.</li> <li>The ability to map attack vectors, explain trade-offs, and use data to move experiments forward while balancing quality, speed, and customer outcomes.</li> <li>Clear writing that explains findings to both engineers and a general audience.</li> <li>Helpful but not required: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience, infrastructure as code with Terraform or OpenTofu, databases or data pipelines at scale, and reverse engineering.</li> </ul> <p>You don't need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing (SAST) engines. A high-level understanding is enough.</p> <p>You don't have to match every listed requirement exactly to be considered. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Threat Research group at GitLab researches security threats as they emerge and turns what we learn into protection for GitLab customers. We maintain the <a href="https://advisories.gitlab.com">GitLab Advisory Database</a>, which powers GitLab's dependency scanning. We also build detection capabilities, do original vulnerability research, and publish what we find. Recent work includes the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/blog/gitlab-discovers-widespread-npm-supply-chain-attack/">Shai-Hulud npm worm</a> and a <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/blog/critical-rce-in-serena/">critical RCE in Serena</a>, a popular MCP coding agent. More on the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/blog/categories/security-labs/">Security Labs blog</a>.</p> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> </div> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> </div> <div><span style="font-size: xx-small;"><span style="color: white;">Remote-Global</span></span></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Senior iOS Engineer, Foundations
description: We are seeking a Senior iOS Engineer to join Raya Foundations, the platform team that owns the shared foundation every other Raya engineering team builds on. On the client side that means the architecture of our iOS codebase, its modularization and build system, shared libraries and design-system components, CI and release tooling, crash and performance infrastructure, and the AI-collaborative development tooling our iOS engineers use every day. This is a senior client engineering role with deep technical impact across a large, long-lived swift iOS codebase. The ideal candidate has built and operated high-scale consumer iOS applications end to end, has been the engineer other iOS engineers come to for architecture and tooling, and is excited about modernizing a mature Swift codebase while keeping it shipping every week. Rather than owning one feature surface, you will partner with the product client teams, server engineering, and design to raise the engineering bar across the whole app. We offer comprehensive medical and dental coverage, $50 a day food delivery budget, equity based employment, a great culture, learning opportunities, unlimited vacation, 12 weeks paid parental leave, and we pay all employees $1,000 a year to go somewhere in the world that they've never been because of our values of human connection, empathy, and curiosity. Responsibilities Own the architecture of Raya's iOS codebase: set the patterns and best practices for state management, SwiftUI adoption, navigation, networking, and concurrency, and solve the hard client-side lifecycle problems that span teams. Drive modernization of a large, long-lived Swift codebase: modularization, SwiftUI alongside UIKit, Swift concurrency, and deliberate management of tech debt. Write the tech specs, make the trade-offs explicit, and sequence the work so it ships incrementally. Build the shared foundation other iOS engineers build on: design-system components, shared libraries, networking and persistence layers, and the dev harness (build times, CI, test infrastructure, release tooling). Build and roll out the AI-collaborative development tooling iOS engineers use every day, and set the standards for how we use it on the client. Improve client production health infrastructure: crash and performance monitoring, alerting, release quality, and the security posture of the app. Partner with server engineering on API design and client-server state sync, and with the product client teams so new features land on solid patterns. Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code review, mentorship, and clear written specs. Requirements 5+ years of professional iOS development experience, with strong proficiency in Swift, UIKit, and MVVM. Strong experience with RxSwift or similar reactive programming frameworks, and with Redux-style state management patterns. A track record of shipping consumer mobile apps to large audiences, with strong judgment on architecture, performance, and user experience. Experience owning client platform or infrastructure work that other engineers depend on (modularizing a large iOS codebase, build and CI systems, shared libraries, design systems, or release tooling) and driving its adoption. Proven ability to lead projects from concept through launch, balance speed and quality, and own what you ship after it ships. You use AI coding tools in your daily work, help the team adopt them, and look for opportunities to improve the engineering harness. What Sets You Apart Deep experience with SwiftUI alongside UIKit and with Swift concurrency (async/await, actors, strict concurrency), including migrating a mature codebase to them. CoreData a plus! Experience with Xcode build performance, Swift Package Manager or Bazel/Tuist, and CI/CD for iOS at scale. Has built developer tooling, agents, or evals that other engineers adopted: code review agents, lint and architecture rules, test generation, or LLM-powered dev harnesses. Occasional comfort or interest in shipping production backend code (Node.js/TypeScript) alongside the client, and designing the APIs mobile clients depend on. Experience with mobile security: device trust, certificate pinning, secrets handling, or security remediation on the client. title: Senior Support Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Support Engineer at GitLab, you'll sit at the intersection of Support and Engineering, helping customers solve complex, real-world challenges while running GitLab in diverse and demanding environments. You'll join the Engineering department and work directly with customers as they encounter edge cases. You'll dig into Linux systems, logs, and our Ruby on Rails codebase to troubleshoot performance issues, reproduce bugs, and contribute merge requests that fix problems at the source.</p> <p>You'll also improve our documentation, refine support processes in our issue tracker, and collaborate closely with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales so customer feedback directly shapes our roadmap. In your first year, you'll build deep expertise across a range of GitLab implementations, strengthen our ability to keep customers productive on both self-managed GitLab and GitLab.com software as a service, and help create tools and content that make support more efficient and effective for the entire team.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlab-detective">A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues</a></li> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlabsos">A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting</a></li> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/sosparser">A tool which turns log files into interactive tables to easily sort and filter columns</a></li> <li><a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/chatops/">A ChatOps feature that makes it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com</a></li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Act as an escalation point for difficult customer interactions and lead the resolution of complex issues through Zendesk tickets, merge requests, email, and video calls.</li> <li>Mentor and guide teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions and cross-team collaboration.</li> <li>Advocate for and drive improvements to support practices, product quality, and reusable documentation and support content that directly influence team objectives.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales teams to shape product goals, roadmaps, and priorities while driving fixes and new features.</li> <li>Participate in regular weekday and weekend on-call rotations during daytime hours, providing emergency support for self-managed GitLab and software as a service customers and coordinating incident communications with the GitLab.com Production team.</li> <li>Participate in hiring by reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews to help grow the Support team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience owning complex, customer-facing technical cases from initial contact through triage, reproduction, bug reporting, resolution, and clear customer communication, including difficult or escalated interactions.</li> <li>Strong experience with Linux systems administration, scripting, Git, and continuous integration and continuous delivery in production or customer environments, with the ability to investigate issues at both the infrastructure and application levels.</li> <li>Ability to mentor teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions, case reviews, and cross-team collaboration.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to turn customer feedback into product fixes, feature improvements, and roadmap priorities.</li> <li>Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless computing, and an understanding of how different GitLab implementations operate and affect customers.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to learn, collaborate across teams, and apply transferable skills from related technical support or engineering roles.</li> <li>Fluent Korean language skills (required)</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We're a globally distributed group of Support Engineers across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, and Asia-Pacific. We work asynchronously and stay connected through pairing sessions, one-on-one meetings, coffee chats, and Slack. We structure our shifts to support our personal lives while meeting customer needs. Thanks to GitLab’s transparency value, you can see what we are working on and how we operate on our<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/support/"> Support Team page</a>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Engineering Productivity Engineer
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for an EngProd Engineer to join our Engineering Operations team and own the engineering experience from local setup to production deploy. You’ll build and integrate the tools our engineers rely on every day: local development, code search, testing, code review, CI, AI-assisted workflows, and the metrics that show where time is being lost. You’ll work closely with other engineering teams at Supabase to eliminate friction, optimize cycle times, and make reliably shipping to production effortless. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that engineers love and that empower them to do their best work. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR In this role, you’ll: - Improve local development and the daily workflow - Own local development environment stability; eliminate “works on my machine,” keep environments reproducible across teams, and make onboarding and setup self-service for every engineer - Improve the daily editing experience, including IDE and editor tooling, extensions, and code search, indexing, and navigation that stays fast as the codebase grows - Build paved roads: project scaffolding, templates, and golden-path workflows that make the right thing the easy thing - Speed up build, test, and CI - Improve our testing tooling and make sure it works well for engineers, including test orchestration, ephemeral end-to-end environments, and techniques like mutation and chaos testing that catch what ordinary tests miss - Profile build and test performance, optimize CI pipelines, parallelize and shard tests, cache aggressively, and hunt down the bottlenecks that leave engineers waiting - Integrate and optimize code review tooling and automated review - Bring AI into how we build - Evaluate, integrate, and promote AI coding agents and assistants where they deliver real leverage without sacrificing quality or maintainability - Build and curate the skills, extensions, and plugins that make those tools effective in our codebase - Measure the real impact of AI tooling so we invest where it actually pays off - Drive engineering excellence - Champion best practices and be a force multiplier for our engineering org - Track productivity metrics and feedback loops (e.g. DORA) to find where cycle time is lost and improve on it - Track code-quality signals such as coverage and mutation testing, and build the dashboards that make quality visible - Establish automation and practices that catch issues early in the development cycle YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Have 7+ years of software engineering experience, with a focus on developer productivity, infrastructure, or platform engineering - Are passionate about developer experience and productivity; you notice when engineers are fighting tools rather than solving problems, and you can’t help but fix it - Are proficient in Go, TypeScript, Python, Rust, and shell and use them to build robust internal tools - You have experience with: - CI/CD systems and pipeline optimization (e.g. Github Actions, ArgoCD, Octopus, Harness) - Local development environments and reproducibility (e.g. devcontainers, Nix, Docker) - AI-assisted development tools such as coding agents and IDE assistants, with a clear point of view on where they help and where they don’t - Test infrastructure and test orchestration, ephemeral end-to-end environments, flaky-test management, and approaches like mutation or chaos testing - Code review and developer workflow tooling, and the automation that streamlines it - Monorepo tooling, build systems, and package managers (e.g. pnpm, Nx, Turborepo, Bazel), including build caching and remote execution - Developer productivity metrics and feedback loops (e.g. DORA), and using data to drive improvements - You’ve made local development environments stable and reproducible across teams - Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences - Have experience in async or globally distributed teams - Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Dutch speaking Support Specialist

If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try! Please make sure to apply with a CV in English. title: Senior Frontend Developer
description: About Divio Divio is a remote-first company spread across Europe. Our core product is a multi-cloud Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) for deploying and managing web applications, used by agencies, developers, and enterprises who want to move fast without DevOps overhead. Alongside our platform, we provide application development and support services to a select group of key enterprise accounts. They rely on us not just for their infrastructure, but also to build, evolve, and support the applications that run on it. Because we run the platform as well as the code, we own the whole chain from development to production. The role You will join a small cross-functional team working on a large, multi-site enterprise application, building re-usable frontend components and complete user-facing features, implementing tools, integrating external services and creating features and functionality that are used across multiple sites and audiences. You will work closely with our backend and infrastructure engineers, our platform team, and the clients themselves. Your work will include: Building features: designing and developing modern, maintainable frontends for client applications, mainly in React and TypeScript. Owning quality: keeping client codebases healthy, secure, accessible, and performant over the long term, not just shipping and moving on. Working with clients: turning requirements into practical solutions, giving estimates, and explaining technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Deploying: taking your work from development to production on the Divio platform and on AWS. Supporting: helping with technical questions and issues on the applications we maintain, as part of a weekly support rotation. Shaping how we work: contributing to frontend standards, reviews and tooling across the project, and having a say in our quarterly objectives. Requirements Who we're looking for We're looking for someone who: Has 7+ years of professional frontend experience, with strong React and TypeScript skills Is comfortable with Node.js Has an excellent understanding of HTML , CSS , Accessibility and web performance Has experience working with headless CMS (e.g. Storyblok ) Is comfortable working directly with clients and translating their needs into working software Is at ease talking with the client directly, in English Takes ownership of what they build, including after it goes live Can work independently but enjoys building things as part of a team Has ideas and wants a say in how things evolve Nice to have: Experience in Static site generation ( Gatsby , Next.js , Astro , …) Experience in AWS and infrastructure as code ( CDK , Lambda , CloudFront , CodeBuild ) Experience in using component libraries or design systems used by many sites Experience in end-to-end and frontend testing (e.g. Playwright ) We're not looking for someone who knows everything, just someone curious, reliable and ready to grow with us. You get freedom in how you work and responsibility for what goes live. There are real challenges, and plenty of chances to learn, improve things and make an impact on the applications we build, on our platform, and on how we work as a team. Salesforce reporting) and LinkedIn. title: Head of M&A
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Head of M&A to join our Corporate Development team and help build M&A from scratch. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, finance, legal, as well as founders we might acquire, helping us build a world class M&A team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR Strategy and sourcing - Map the markets and targets that matter to Supabase's roadmap, and keep the map current. - Decide build vs buy each quarter for key product areas, together with Product and Engineering. - Build relationships with founders early, and convert the ones we want. Running deals - Write the case for, price, and negotiate deals, from valuation model to term sheet to close. - Run diligence and integration end to end alongside Engineering, People, Finance, and Legal. - Set and own integration milestones, and track every deal against the reason we did it. Building the function - Build automation for target discovery, relationship tracking, and diligence. - Build the Supabase M&A muscle, and improve it after every deal. - Note: Supabase is here to scale revenue, not headcount. You should be as comfortable as a IC as a cross functional leader, and want to build the system, not the org chart. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Have 7+ years of experience in M&A - Are comfortable in highly technical domains. - Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences - Have experience in async or globally distributed teams - Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Customer Engineering Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Mexico City, Mexico</strong></h3> <h3><strong>What you’ll do as a Solutions Engineer Manager</strong></h3> <p>As a SE Manager for Cloudflare for the LATAM Markets  you will be responsible for managing a cross functional, full sales life cycle and technical activities for Cloudflare customers. The role requires someone with strong leadership, interpersonal, and business acumen to work with Sales to grow our account base. The SE Manager will manage a team of SEs that are geographically distributed within the US and Mexico, covering all of the countries that make up LATAM for Cloudflare.  The SE team partners with the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Public Sector LATAM Sales teams that are also geographically distributed in the US and Mexico, as well as Customer Success and is responsible for providing the value of Cloudflare products to customers and prospects</p> <h3><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, experience and goals</strong></h3> <p>Our Solutions Engineers come from a wide range of backgrounds: financial consulting, engineering, software development, product management, customer support & project delivery. We're serious about building a diverse team. When hiring we look for diversity of experience combined with genuine curiosity for our technology.</p> <p>Ultimately, you are passionate about technology and people, and have the ability to explain complex technical concepts in easy-to-understand terms, and you like coaching and teaching. You are naturally curious, and an avid builder who is not afraid to get your hands dirty. On the Solutions Engineering team, you will find a collaborative environment where everyone brings different strengths and jumps in to help each other and you will be an integral part of driving that culture.</p> <p><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Management Information Systems or another related field or its equivalent.</li> <li>3+ years of experience with internet technologies / protocols and / or cloud technologies</li> <li>Minimum 1 year of team lead/team management experience</li> <li>Experience managing opportunity sales cycles and identifying technical proof activities </li> <li>Demonstrated operations and organization skills implementation and driving best practices with cross functional organizations.</li> <li>Strong organizational and analytical skills.</li> <li>Outstanding interpersonal skills with a proven track record of successfully building collaboration around important initiatives.</li> <li>Successful track record of working and influencing matrixed organizations.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to effectively present technical and business related subjects to all audiences.</li> <li>Demonstrated problem solving skills, drive for results, interpersonal savvy, and customer focus.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. You'll collaborate with product management, product design, testing, security, user experience research, technical writing, Gitaly, Code Review, and the other Source Code teams.<br><br><strong>What you'll do</strong></div> <ul> <li>Develop secure, well-tested, performant features and improvements using Ruby and GraphQL.</li> <li>Work through complex requirements and legacy constraints to deliver clear solutions while protecting the reliability of this critical system.</li> <li>Design and maintain backend services, application programming interfaces, data models, and business logic that maintainable code that follows GitLab's standards and contribute to constructive code reviews.</li> <li>Help strengthen reliability by monitoring production health metrics, participating in Tier 2 <div><strong>What you'll bring</strong></div> <ul> <li>Professional experience building backend web applications, services, or application programming interfaces, with experience using Ruby and GraphQL.</li> <li>An understanding of relational databases, structured query language, data modeling, caching, background processing, and backend performance practices.</li> <li>Experience contributing to user-facing workflows and maintaining their underlying systems.</li> <li>Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with the testing pyramid, Git, and collaborative code review processes.</li> <li>Experience using artificial intelligence coding agents and reviewing their output, or an interest in building these skills in a complex monorepo.</li> <li>Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates in a remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li>The ability to manage assigned priorities, work through ambiguity, take ownership of your work, and seek guidance when needed.</li> </ul> <div><br><strong>About the team</strong><br>Repository Services is a small backend team in the Create stage, title: Finance Controller
description: Finance Controller Location: Netherlands Start date: Q1 2027 Compensation: €70k - €80k annually (depending on experience) Employment type: Full-time (contractor if outside Netherlands) About DTACT DTACT (Data Transform Act) is a data technology company that helps organizations transform complex information into clear, actionable insights. Founded in 2016, we work with government agencies and enterprises across Europe to solve critical data challenges and support better decision-making in areas such as cybersecurity, defense, intelligence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Built on deep expertise in these domains, we develop innovative solutions that help organizations gain greater visibility, understanding, and control over their data. As a fully remote and internationally distributed company, we combine technical excellence with a collaborative and adaptable way of working. Our mission is simple: to help organizations turn information into action, enabling faster, smarter decisions when they matter most. The Role We are looking for a Finance Controller to own DTACT’s finance function end-to-end as we continue to scale internationally. Reporting into the COO, you’ll take full ownership of accounting, collections, financial analytics, budgeting, and compliance (including our Dutch statutory obligations) — acting as the single point of accountability for finance in the business today. This is a hands-on, mid-level role: you’ll be expected to run the entire finance function largely on your own in the near term, while also bringing the leadership mindset and ambition to grow the function — and your own role — as DTACT expands. What you'll do Own end-to-end accounting operations — AP/AR, general ledger, and month end/year-end close — ensuring accurate, timely financial reporting. Manage the full collections process: invoicing, aging follow-up, and cash flow forecasting. Build and maintain finance analytics (dashboards, reports) that give leadership clear, real-time visibility into company performance. Own the budgeting and forecasting cycle, partnering with department leads to track actuals against plan. Ensure full compliance with Dutch tax and statutory reporting requirements (VAT, annual accounts) and manage relationships with external accountants, auditors, banks, and tax advisors. Partner with People Operations on payroll processing and accuracy across jurisdictions, and own administration of the employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP). Build and continuously improve finance processes, technical efficiencies and controls, laying the groundwork as the company grows. What you'll bring 5–8 years of progressive finance/accounting experience, including hands-on ownership of a full finance function — ideally within tech in a startup or scale-up environment. Solid knowledge of Dutch accounting standards, tax regulations, statutory compliance requirements and payroll. Proven ability to independently manage accounting, collections, budgeting, and financial analytics without a large supporting team. Strong analytical skills and financial modeling ability; comfortable turning data into clear, actionable insights. Leadership potential and genuine ambition to grow into a finance leadership role as the team and company scale. A hands-on, “roll up your sleeves” attitude, paired with the ability to think and plan strategically. Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch. What's in for you Competitive compensation and equity participation , including an Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP), allowing you to share in DTACT's long-term success. Remote-first flexibility , with the opportunity to work from anywhere within compatible time zones and a schedule that supports both collaboration and personal needs. A trust-based culture built around asynchronous communication , empowering people to work independently while staying connected and aligned across teams. Generous time off , including vacation days and local public holidays to help you rest, recharge, and maintain a healthy work-life balance. Home office support , including high-quality equipment and a budget to create a productive and comfortable workspace. An international and diverse team , where English is our company language and collaboration spans multiple countries, backgrounds, and perspectives. High-impact work: DTACT helps organizations in and outside the government with mitigating their vulnerabilities and providing alerts to incoming threats. We believe diverse teams build better solutions. DTACT welcomes applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background or identity. We hire based on skills, experience, and potential, and encourage everyone who meets the role requirements to apply. Please note: Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Digital Customer Outcomes team brings digital experiences and human support together around customer outcomes.
