title: Freelance Product Manager – AI for Quality & Regulatory
description: About Acodis Acodis is a Swiss software company based in Winterthur, providing AI-driven document processing for global Life Sciences companies. We help Quality and Regulatory teams move from document-centric to data-driven ways of working. The Mandate We are looking for an experienced freelance Product Manager to turn our AI platform into dedicated product solutions for two use cases. Working directly with management and our product engineering team, you will own both from discovery to market launch. Quality – Batch Record Review: AI-assisted review of executed batch records: checking completeness and correctness of entries, flagging deviations and GMP-relevant exceptions, and shortening review cycles ahead of batch disposition. Regulatory – CMC & Regulatory Submissions: Extraction and reuse of CMC data for submissions (CTD Module 3), consistency checks between source documents and submission content, and support for variations and post-approval changes. Mandate Deliverables Product definition & validation: Customer interviews, validated user workflows and value cases, and engineering-ready specifications and roadmap for both use cases. Pilot support: In our running pilots, including success criteria and a GxP-compliant validation approach. Go-to-market: Positioning, messaging, input and launch materials, together with the commercial team. Required Expertise 8+ years in product management or product consulting for digital, AI or enterprise software in Life Sciences. Hands-on expertise in batch record review and GMP manufacturing, or in CMC and regulatory submissions, with a solid understanding of GxP, data integrity and computerised system validation. Track record of taking products from concept to market, working independently on defined mandates. Nice to have: Experience with AI/LLM-based document processing, data pipelines, or platforms such as Veeva, MasterControl, Snowflake or Databricks. Mandate Details Duration & workload: 3–6 months from Jan/Feb 2027, 80–100%, extension possible. Location: Fully remote; no on-site presence in Winterthur required, but possible. Contract: Freelance (self-employed or via your own company) What We Offer A clearly scoped mandate with autonomy in how you deliver it. Direct access to management, engineering and customers, with short decision paths. The chance to shape two flagship products, with potential for a follow-on mandate. How to Apply Please upload your CV and relevant references, availability and daily rate to our recruiting platform. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Embedded & Desktop Linux Systems Engineer - Optimisation
description: <p>Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world’s most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.</p> <p>The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that’s challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">This is a Globally remote role</span></em></p> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">What your day will look like</span></h2> <ul> <li>Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks</li> <li>Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms</li> <li>Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics</li> <li>Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge</li> <li>Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server</li> <li>Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.</li> </ul> <p>Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.</p> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">What we are looking for in you</span></h2> <ul> <li>You love technology and working with brilliant people</li> <li>You have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar </li> <li>You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)</li> <li>You have experience working with open source communities and licences</li> <li>You have experience working with C, C++</li> <li>You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">Additional skills that you might also bring</span></h2> <ul> <li>Experience with graphics stacks</li> <li>Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST</li> <li>Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments</li> <li>Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience</li> <li>IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services</li> <li>Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">What we offer you</span></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.  </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Annual compensation review</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Recognition rewards</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Annual holiday leave</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Parental Leave</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Employee Assistance Programme</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</span></li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">About Canonical</span></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</span></p> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</span></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. </span><a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</span></a></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-remote </span></p>

title: Senior Principal Risk Analyst
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work, and protecting that trust is foundational to everything we build. Notion is flexible, powerful and always evolving. It is a product that needs to scale to meet the needs of many thousands of businesses globally. Those customers rely on us to protect their data and their customers’ data. This is where you come in — to help us forge a strong, reliable path forward to the future. Notion is looking for a risk analyst who has a passion for partnering with teams across the organization to envision, plan and enhance Notion's risk management posture. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Mature and scale Notion’s security risk management program, creating practical, and repeatable processes for identifying, assessing, monitoring, and addressing risk. - Manage the security risk register, partnering with risk owners to document and prioritize risks, maintain current treatment plans, and track progress through resolution or approved acceptance. - Strengthen third-party risk management across the vendor lifecycle, from due diligence and onboarding through continuous monitoring, reassessment, and offboarding. - Identify sensitive data exposure risks, assess and improve data loss prevention controls, and drive remediation that protects company and customer data. - Collaborate across Security, Engineering, IT, Procurement, Legal, and business teams to develop proportionate controls and move risk treatment plans forward. - Develop risk metrics and reporting that give leadership a clear view of the company’s risk posture, emerging concerns, and remediation progress. - Identify opportunities to improve and automate risk workflows, making it easier for teams to make informed decisions as Notion scales. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Security risk management: You have experience building or scaling information security risk programs, including work with risk assessments, risk registers, treatment plans, and risk acceptance processes. - Technical fluency: You understand security concepts across cloud infrastructure, applications, identity and access, and data protection, and can assess how control gaps translate into business risk. - Third-party risk expertise: You have experience evaluating vendor security practices, assessing residual risk, and managing risk throughout the third-party lifecycle. - Strategic judgment: You can prioritize competing risks, navigate ambiguity, and recommend pragmatic solutions that balance security, business needs, and operational realities. - Cross-functional influence: You build productive relationships with technical and business partners and drive progress without relying on direct authority. - Communication and reporting: You translate complex risks into clear, actionable narratives for audiences ranging from engineers and risk owners to senior leadership. - Builder mentality: You improve processes and use technology or automation to reduce manual work while maintaining sound oversight. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience or certifications in the governance, risk, or privacy domains. - Awareness of ongoing and recent developments across the security risk landscape. - Working knowledge of Notion and how AI agents can be used to enhance security programs. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $208,000 - $245,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Manager, Corporate Security - Platform Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of the role</strong></h4> <p>As Manager, Corporate Security - Platform Engineering, you'll lead a small, distributed team of security engineers and own programs that span Corporate Security teams. You'll define clear team boundaries, run security tooling through GitOps-based engineering practices, and bring program priorities, budgets, and vendor decisions to Security leadership. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you won't be the primary implementer, but you'll write code, review designs and merge requests, make architecture decisions, and support incident response. This role is remote within North America, reports to the VP, Corporate Security, and is at job level M3 (Manager, Security Engineering).</p> <h4><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead, hire, coach, and develop security engineers, including Staff engineers setting technical direction in artificial intelligence (AI) security and cloud environments. Build clear career paths and support ownership, written communication, and psychological safety.</li> <li>Own the lifecycle of shared security tools, from evaluation and procurement through renewal and retirement. Use infrastructure-as-code repositories and GitOps practices, and give each tool a named owner, budget line, and exit plan. Initial priorities include Axonius, Push Security, Island, Material Security, the transition from Koi to Fleet osquery, and the CrowdStrike contract split with Security Operations.</li> <li>Lead the secure access service edge (SASE) and always-on virtual private network (VPN) rollout, and own data loss prevention policy. Coordinate Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) boundary decisions with Security Compliance, working with Endpoint Engineering on clients and device posture signals and Identity Engineering on Okta network-zone policy.</li> <li>Run the corporate email gateway and own domain-based message authentication, reporting, and conformance (DMARC), sender policy framework (SPF), and DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) across GitLab domains, including the FedRAMP tenant. Complete the separation of product email flow from corporate Google Workspace.</li> <li>Operate Sandbox Cloud across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including the self-service portal, demo and training environments, the SSP GitLab instance, and other gitlab.systems environments. Build automated deprovisioning and cost guardrails while keeping identity and access management with Identity Engineering and production infrastructure with Infrastructure Security and Site Reliability Engineering.</li> <li>Own Corporate Security's operating-model reporting, annual operating plan, software spend, change management, systems directory, handbook upkeep, and dashboards. Coordinate audit evidence across all three teams for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC 2), and FedRAMP, replacing screenshots with code and query exports.</li> <li>Run departmental intake and reduce repeated requests through Slack automation, Serval, self-service security reviews, documentation hubs, and AI-assisted answers. Help each team focus on the systems it owns rather than routine triage.</li> <li>Represent Platform Engineering in Corporate Security and Security leadership forums, the Authorization to Operate Council, and monthly AI spend reviews. Partner with Corporate IT, Infrastructure Security, security incident response, Security Compliance, Security Risk, Enterprise AI, Legal and Privacy, Procurement, and Finance to resolve shared priorities and ownership questions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience managing security or platform engineering teams across time zones, including hiring engineers and developing senior individual contributors. Experience defining a team's remit and redirecting work to the right owner.</li> <li>Experience owning several categories of corporate security tooling, such as network security, email security, software-as-a-service security posture, asset visibility, and cloud sandboxes. Sound judgment about when to adopt, consolidate, or retire tools.</li> <li>Experience leading a team that operates tools as code using Terraform or OpenTofu, GitOps, merge-request change management, continuous integration pipelines, and Python or a similar language. The technical depth to review designs and code.</li> <li>Hands-on experience deploying SASE, zero-trust network access, or always-on VPN solutions, alongside data loss prevention controls, in a remote-first company.</li> <li>Knowledge of AWS and GCP organization structures, account provisioning, guardrails, and cost controls sufficient to operate a self-service sandbox platform safely.</li> <li>Experience owning objectives and key results, vendor relationships, budgets, and security audit evidence programs, with the ability to write clear, concise plans for senior Security leadership.</li> <li>Experience using agentic AI tools in your work and a clear approach to governing AI tools, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and credentials. The ability to run an enablement program without becoming the approver for every tool.</li> <li>Clear written and asynchronous communication, a record of resolving ownership questions across functions, and an approach aligned with GitLab's values and all-remote, handbook-first ways of working. We welcome diverse backgrounds and transferable experience relevant to this work.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>About the team</strong></h4> <p>Platform Engineering owns shared security tooling, non-production environments, and department-wide programs within Corporate Security. The team works alongside Endpoint Engineering and Identity Engineering, with clear boundaries around each team's responsibilities. Its focus is to make security services easier to operate and use through automation, self-service, and written documentation, while keeping ownership, costs, and audit evidence clear. You'll lead a small, distributed team and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with technical, security, and business partners.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. the Senior Manager of Application Security.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do </strong></h4> <ul> <li>Conduct and lead security research projects across multiple functional areas.</li> <li>Identify than the instance.</li> <li>Lead security research into GitLab's AI and agentic surfaces, and define the security requirements that engineering teams build against.</li> <li>Build and direct the tooling and automation that scales security research, including agent-assisted vulnerability discovery across our codebase.</li> <li>Research the security posture of open source tools and dependencies novel vulnerability types with the security community.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in security research, penetration testing, or offensive security roles</li> <li>Strong ability in discovering and exploiting vulnerabilities in large codebase and complex systems</li> <li>Proficiency in two or more of Ruby, Go, Python, TypeScript, or Rust. </li> <li>Ability to read and analyze code across multiple languages and codebases</li> <li>Strong knowledge of AI frameworks</li> <li>Strong understanding of AI attack vectors including prompt security challenges facing GitLab and its customers to enable GitLab to be the most secure software factory platform on the market. Reporting to the Security Risk Manager, you will bring expertise on risk methodology, risk-based thinking, and AI-enablement. </p> <p>In this role, you'll partner closely with Security, Legal, IT, Product, and Engineering to translate technical findings and vendor risk into business-relevant risk statements and risk treatments. analysis and program maturity.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Own risk identification, analysis, and prioritization across third-party risk (TPRM), security risk remediation progress, and trends.</li> <li>Own and mature AI risk management, including AI impact assessments, AI risk assessments, and risk treatments, to support ISO 42001 certification.</li> This is a software engineering role, not ticket-taking internal IT, AI evangelism disconnected from shipped code, or customer-billable Professional Services delivery.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Use Claude Code, GitLab Duo, and other coding agents as your primary development environment for planning, implementation, refactoring, testing, reviews, and documentation. Run multiple agents in parallel on well-scoped tasks, critically review their output, and own every line that reaches production.</li> <li>Build and maintain the team's agent harness, including shared AGENTS.md conventions, skills, slash commands, hooks, subagent definitions, and continuous integration checks. Measure and share what works, publish reusable patterns, and retire those that don't.</li> <li>Ship agents and multi-step workflows for account research, success planning, scoping, status reporting, and customer onboarding. Package them as skills and plugins for non-engineers using Claude, Claude in Slack, and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.</li> <li>Build MCP servers and connectors for governed access to GitLab, Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, Thought Industries, Gong, Snowflake, and other enterprise systems. Add evaluations, tracing, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints to keep internal and customer-facing agents measurable, auditable, and safe with customer data.</li> <li>Evolve the CX Application Platform's gateway, Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure, including Elastic Container Service (ECS), Relational Database Service (RDS), and Lambda, Terraform configuration, application scaffold, and deployment path. Own applications such as PS Compass, Congregate, and GitLab University and its integrations, documenting build-versus-buy and consolidate-or-sunset decisions.</li> <li>Ship production-quality Python and TypeScript through GitLab continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), with tests, observability, security review, and runbooks. Design every application for handoff, with documentation, monitoring, and shared ownership.</li> <li>Prototype with Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training in days, not quarters. Help CX team members bring their own applications to production, and turn field learning into reusable reference implementations, development paths, and enablement.</li> <li>Contribute upstream to GitLab and share product feedback with Product and Engineering. Mentor engineers and non-engineers on agentic development and raise the team's code review bar.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience building and operating production software, owning multi-quarter work from ambiguity to production, choosing reusable platform solutions over one-off customization where appropriate, and designing for handoff.</li> <li>Daily, hands-on use of coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitLab Duo, or similar on production work. You can show how they've changed what you ship and how you maintain quality.</li> <li>Experience building with large language models (LLMs) beyond chat, including tool use, MCP servers, agent loops, context and retrieval design, prompt and workflow design, and evaluations.</li> <li>Strong Python skills with FastAPI or Flask and TypeScript skills with Vue or React, including application programming interface (API) design, authentication, authorization, and secure handling of customer and business data.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with AWS ECS, RDS, and Lambda, Terraform, Docker, and applications running behind single sign-on (SSO), such as Okta.</li> <li>Experience integrating enterprise systems through Representational State Transfer (REST) and GraphQL APIs, and fluency with Git, merge requests, and CI/CD.</li> <li>Experience translating non-engineering stakeholders' workflows into technical plans and writing clear asynchronous design documents, decision records, and enablement materials. You align with GitLab's values and are willing to use GitLab for your own work.</li> <li>Optional experience includes agent harness customization; the GitLab Development Kit, Duo Agent Platform custom agents and flows, or AI Catalog publishing; enterprise agent governance and data controls; customer success, professional services, or learning platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, or Thought Industries; professional services economics and customer success metrics; Snowflake or similar warehouses; and technical writing, talks, or open source contributions on agentic development.</li> </ul> <p>We welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; you don't need to meet every nice-to-have to apply.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>CX Platform Engineering builds and runs CX Applications for Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training. We own the CX Application Platform's gateway and infrastructure alongside our application portfolio: GitLab University, the Foundational Onboarding Agent in GitLab Duo Agent Platform, Congregate, PS Compass, and Customer Wins. We build the first version with the people doing the work, turn what we learn into a reusable pattern, then hand it off so it runs without us. We reward leverage, not heroics, and don't leave tools dependent on one person.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. You'll design high-level architectures and implementation plans for GitLab infrastructure and functionality, and you'll make sure deliverables align with customer requirements and the Statement of Work (SOW). You'll coordinate and guide implementation work across GitLab Professional Services and partner consultants, support customers deploying GitLab in cloud and on-premises environments using tools like Terraform, Ansible, and the GitLab Environment Toolkit, and perform migrations to GitLab using Congregate. You'll provide DevOps and DevSecOps consulting and best practices, contribute reusable collateral such as documentation, delivery kits, and training materials, and share product release updates to help the team deliver consistent outcomes. This role combines deep technical expertise with customer-facing leadership in GitLab's remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Designing and delivering GitLab reference architecture implementations for both self-managed and cloud environments, using infrastructure as code practices</li> <li>Leading source code management and CI/CD migrations to GitLab, including large-scale enterprise moves using Congregate</li> <li>Building repeatable delivery kits, documentation, and enablement materials that help Professional Services and partners deploy and adopt GitLab best practices</li> <li>Lead the full technical delivery lifecycle for GitLab Professional Services engagements, from early scoping and technical discovery through implementation and handoff.</li> <li>Produce high-level and detailed technical designs for GitLab infrastructure and functionality, ensuring deliverables align with customer requirements and expectations.</li> <li>Evaluate and communicate scalability and security considerations (including compliance constraints) in proposed GitLab reference architectures and implementation plans.</li> <li>Deploy and configure GitLab in customer environments, including on-premises and major cloud providers, using Terraform, Ansible, and the GitLab Environment Toolkit (GET) aligned to reference architectures.</li> <li>Plan and execute source system migrations to GitLab using Congregate, partnering closely with customer stakeholders to reduce risk, protect data integrity, and minimize downtime.</li> <li>Provide DevOps and DevSecOps consulting and best-practice guidance, including advising on internal frameworks such as the Delivery Governance Framework (DGF) and GitLab Flow.</li> <li>Coordinate and oversee implementation work across GitLab team members, partners, and customer points of contact (POCs), ensuring clear asynchronous communication and decision capture, effective execution, and high-quality outcomes.</li> <li>Mentor Professional Services and partner consultants by contributing documentation, delivery kits, and training materials, and by leading enablement sessions on how to deliver and position service offerings.</li> <li>Maintain and improve delivery automation assets with an emphasis on code cleanliness, maintainability, and appropriate unit/integration testing.</li> <li>Support scoping and Statement of Work (SOW) creation with Professional Services Engagement Managers, stay current on monthly GitLab releases, and help Regional Delivery Managers with technical vetting and staffing assessments while maintaining a 55% billable utilization.</li> <li>Review and provide input to Professional Services training materials and presentations</li> <li>Develop case studies, presentations, design documentation, and best-practice methodologies</li> <li>Work closely with customer project teams to ensure accurate task-level articulation of work required</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead technical discussions with customers and partners and communicate risks/trade-offs clearly in an asynchronous environment.</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Prefer location in PST, MST or CST timezone alignment. Comfortable with up to 30% travel at times.</strong></li> <li>Demonstrated experience delivering two or more of the following consulting services: source code management migration, cloud architecture, DevOps engineering, or continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) consulting services.</li> <li>Enterprise software development experience, with the ability to translate requirements into clear technical designs and implementation plans.Progressive DevOps platform experience, including designing and implementing reliable, scalable systems with clear performance and security trade-offs.</li> <li>Hands-on experience deploying and managing infrastructure in cloud providers and on-premises environments, including using tools such as Terraform and Ansible.Ability to write clean, maintainable automation/integration code (e.g., Terraform modules, Ansible roles, scripts) and validate changes with appropriate testing and code review.</li> <li>Experience performing migrations to GitLab, including using Congregate or similar migration tooling.Working knowledge of data consistency and integrity concepts (e.g., ACID properties) and how they impact migration design and performance trade-offs.Strong problem-solving, decision-making, organizational, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.</li> <li>Comfort working in a remote, asynchronous environment, using documented decisions (e.g., issues, proposals, and runbooks) to keep work unblocked across time zones while collaborating effectively across GitLab team members, partners, and customer stakeholders.Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or other advanced technical degree, or equivalent experience</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Professional Services Technical Architect is part of GitLab's Professional Services organization. We partner with customers who are transitioning to GitLab, expanding how they use an existing GitLab installation, or planning complex upgrades to their infrastructure and processes. Our team brings a diverse set of skills across GitLab deployment, maintenance, and day-to-day usage, along with deep technical knowledge of adjacent tools and platforms. Working closely with Engagement Managers, partner consultants, and customer stakeholders, we focus on delivering high-quality outcomes, sharing best practices, and helping customers realize faster time to value from their GitLab investment. We operate in GitLab's remote, asynchronous environment and rely on clear documentation and transparent communication to collaborate effectively.</p> <p>This role models skills and behavior aligned with GitLab Values and typically reports to the Regional Delivery Manager. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Senior Renewals Manager at GitLab, you'll own renewal planning and execution for public sector customers. You'll develop renewal strategies, forecast outcomes, and coordinate with Sales and Customer Success to address risks and support long-term customer relationships. You'll also improve renewal workflows so customers experience seamless continuity with GitLab's platform.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Implementing automated outreach sequences to engage customers throughout their renewal lifecycle</li> <li value="2">Enhancing customer experience by integrating adoption data and personalized communications into renewal processes</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Own the renewal process for a portfolio of public sector customers, developing account-level strategies and coordinating renewal activities from planning through completion.</li> <li value="2">Collaborate closely with public sector Sales and Customer Success teams to align on renewal plans, address customer risks, and ensure seamless renewal experiences.</li> <li value="3">Monitor customer health and adoption data to forecast renewal opportunities accurately.</li> <li value="4">Execute outreach campaigns through established sequences, personalizing communications to maintain strong customer relationships and drive on-time renewals.</li> <li value="5">Drive customer retention and timely renewals, taking ownership of renewal risks and coordinating actions to resolve them.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Experience owning customer renewal strategies, managing competing priorities, and improving renewal processes.</li> <li value="2">Experience working in a collaborative, customer-facing environment where you coordinate with multiple internal teams to support renewal forecasting and customer retention.</li> <li value="3">Familiarity with CRM and customer success tools such as Salesforce and Gainsight, and the ability to interpret customer health and adoption data to inform renewal strategies.</li> <li value="4">Strong communication skills with confidence to engage in business conversations and deliver excellent customer experiences.</li> <li value="5">Demonstrated discipline in time and project management, with the ability to prioritize outreach and renewal activities effectively.</li> <li value="6">Openness to learning and adapting, with a coachable mindset and willingness to implement feedback for continuous improvement.</li> <li value="7">Customer-centric approach with high empathy, focused on building long-term relationships and driving customer satisfaction.</li> <li value="8">We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who can demonstrate the experience and transferable skills needed to own renewal outcomes.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Renewals team at GitLab manages the end-to-end renewal process for a large portfolio of customers and is dedicated to driving customer retention and growth. Our mission is to support long-term customer success through data-driven insights and close collaboration with Customer Success and Sales teams to proactively engage customers, identify risks and opportunities, and ensure timely renewals. We operate in a global, asynchronous environment, using tools like Salesforce, Gainsight, and Gong to coordinate efforts and maintain high standards of customer satisfaction. title: Fullstack Engineer, Source Code: Repository Services (Ruby)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As an Intermediate Fullstack Engineer, you will take backend features and improvements from clarifying the problem through shipping them and following up in production. You will work within a product area, partnering with Product Management, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Security to deliver predictably and contribute to the quality, security, performance, and maintainability of shared backend code and services. You will be trusted to work with minimal guidance, to know when to seek help, and to communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous environment — with other tenured engineers alongside you to review your work, think through hard problems with you, and help you grow.</p> <h2><strong>Why you’ll love this role</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Ownership:</strong> You'll take features from requirements through delivery and follow-up; your code will run on a platform used by millions of users.</li> <li><strong>Learning and Growth :</strong> You’ll work alongside your engineering team, who treat code review and design review as a learning loop rather than a gate — one of the fastest ways to grow your engineering judgment.</li> <li><strong>Innovative Culture:</strong> You’ll use AI as a genuine part of daily engineering work, developing the judgment to know when to trust it and when not to.</li> <li><strong>Autonomy:</strong> You’ll thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.</li> <li><strong>User-Centric Collaboration:</strong> You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, so you understand why you’re building something, not just what.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own and Ship Features:</strong> Design, implement, test, and ship backend features and improvements with minimal guidance, working in Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern languages.</li> <li><strong>Build for Production:</strong> Write maintainable, secure, observable, and performant code. Design and maintain APIs, background jobs, integrations, and bounded service functionality, and work with data models, migrations, indexes, and query behavior.</li> <li><strong>Test and Review:</strong> Add and improve automated coverage — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end where appropriate — and review others’ code for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and operational risk.</li> <li><strong>Operate What You Build:</strong> Investigate build, test, deployment, and runtime failures at the feature boundary, identify technical debt and propose practical improvements, and take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> <li><strong>Leverage AI:</strong> Use AI productively in daily work, validate what it produces, and understand where its limitations matter.</li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1"><strong>On Call Support: </strong>Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</span></li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Backend Fundamentals:</strong> Professional experience building and shipping production backend applications, with strong programming, API, database, testing, debugging, and performance fundamentals.</li> <li><strong>Adaptability:</strong> Experience with Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern backend language. We value the ability to learn and adapt over mastery of a single language.</li> <li><strong>Feature Ownership:</strong> The ability to take a feature from clarification through delivery and follow-up, working independently while seeking input at the right time.</li> <li><strong>Practical Judgment:</strong> Sound instincts about security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational risk, plus an understanding of modular backend boundaries and the consequences of coupling.</li> <li><strong>Clear Communication:</strong> Strong written communication and effective collaboration in a remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li><strong>AI Fluency:</strong> Practical experience with AI coding tools, including the ability to review and correct what they generate.</li> </ul> particularly for systems, security, performance, or platform work.</li> <li>PostgreSQL, schema evolution, caching, queues, messaging, or event-driven workflows.</li> <li>Observability using metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerts.</li> <li>Contributing to a modular monolith, bounded context, shared component, or independently operated service.</li> </ul> <div title: Senior Third Party Risk Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£85,000 - £115,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨<br><br></p> <p><strong>⭐️ Our Third Party & Outsourcing Risk Management Team</strong></p> <p>We are a high-performing Global team focused on delivering pragmatic Third Party Risk Management (‘TPRM’) that protects Monzo and our customers globally. As Monzo expands across new markets and scales its product range, the operational footprint is growing fast, and the operating environment is becoming more complex.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Senior Third Party Risk Manager </strong>to help shape and deliver our approach.  As well as ensuring Monzo’s TPRM has well defined controls, processes and governance models in place to meet the continually growing and evolving demands of global Third Party Risk Management regulations - you’ll also set priorities and turn them into measurable improvements.</p> <p>Reporting to the Director of Third Party Risk, this is a <strong>hands-on </strong>role, with strategic scope. You’ll work across the global team, and with a variety of stakeholders throughout Monzo, to strengthen our framework, manage complex risks and improve how we deliver TPRM both tactically and strategically. </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Delivering Core TPRM Operations Globally</strong>: Operating end-to-end operational activities, including supplier tiering, materiality assessments, due diligence reviews, exit planning support, and regulatory reporting.</li> <li><strong>Driving Operational Excellence:</strong> Taking ownership of process quality, making sure TPRM activities are completed accurately, consistently and on time. You’ll look for ways to improve how we manage third party risk in practice.</li> <li><strong>Helping shape our priorities: </strong>Identifying emerging risks, gaps and opportunities across third party risk management, and making recommendations to inform the team’s strategy and roadmap. You’ll develop practical solutions and help deliver improvements through to completion.</li> <li><strong>Enabling Strategic Delivery:</strong> Supporting and feeding into higher-level strategic initiatives and complex risk landscapes. Leading agreed initiatives from problem definition through implementation autonomously, working across teams and global markets to deliver measurable improvements and ensuring clear visibility throughout.</li> <li><strong>Collaborating Across Teams:</strong> Working directly with internal stakeholders across the 3LOD, and external suppliers to clear blockers, follow up on actions, and resolve issues effectively.</li> <li><strong>Sharing your expertise:</strong> Support colleagues and stakeholders with practical guidance, helping them understand how to deliver their third party risk responsibilities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You know Outsourcing, Third Party Risk & Regulation: </strong>You have substantial practical TPRM experience (ideally in banking or financial services) operating in both the UK and EU financial markets.  </li> <li><strong>You’ve contributed to a risk strategy, framework or operating model: </strong>You can demonstrate how you translated an identified gap into a practical improvement.</li> <li><strong>You’re comfortable leading complex assessments:</strong> You make balanced, well-reasoned recommendations when information is incomplete or stakeholders have different priorities.</li> <li><strong>You have experience working with various technologies</strong>: TPR tooling and AI to build innovative solutions and streamline operational workflows.</li> <li><strong>You hold a high quality bar:</strong> You pay close attention to detail and care about accuracy. You use data and reporting to spot patterns, make evidence-based decisions and improve processes.</li> <li><strong>You take ownership:</strong> You work independently, take initiative and prioritise your workload in a fast-moving environment. You use sound risk judgement and know when to seek guidance or involve others.</li> <li><strong>You focus on outcomes, not just activity: </strong>You measure success by what has materially improved whether that's faster turnaround times, clearer risk ownership, or cleaner supplier data.</li> <li><strong>You are a clear, pragmatic communicator: </strong>You build strong relationships with internal teams, third parties and regulators. You’re comfortable holding colleagues accountable and offering constructive challenges when needed. title: Customer Success LATAM
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Customer Success Manager for Latin America (LATAM), you’ll help GitLab customers in the region realize the full value of our development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) platform by driving adoption, measurable outcomes, and long-term advocacy. You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to a portfolio of customers, guiding them on Git, branching strategies, the software development lifecycle, continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps best practices.</p> <p>This role requires more technical depth than a typical Customer Success Manager role, but not the same level of technical expertise as a Customer Success Engineer. You’ll need to learn and use GitLab hands-on, triage technical questions, and guide customers on product and infrastructure best practices, while keeping adoption and business outcomes at the center of your work.</p> <p>In this role, you’ll connect customer goals with GitLab capabilities, lead workshops and Centers of Excellence efforts, and translate product usage data into clear, actionable recommendations for both customers and GitLab account teams. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Professional Services, with success in your first year measured by customer satisfaction, retention, and the strength of the strategic relationships you build.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Build and maintain a trusted advisor relationship with each assigned customer in LATAM, focusing on adoption, measurable outcomes, and long-term satisfaction with GitLab.</li> <li value="2">Triage customers’ technical questions, provide product and infrastructure best practices, and help customers establish a GitLab Center of Excellence within their organization.</li> <li value="3">Lead workshops and provide hands-on product enablement to help customers understand and use the full value of the GitLab solution across their software development lifecycle.</li> <li value="4">Measure and monitor customers’ progress against critical and key performance indicators, and share insights with GitLab account stakeholders and customer sponsors and executives.</li> <li value="5">Translate customer product usage data into clear, actionable recommendations that drive adoption and expansion of GitLab within customer environments.</li> <li value="6">Establish and manage regular touchpoints with customers in line with service level agreements to review strategic and technical objectives and adjust plans as needed.</li> <li value="7">Collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Professional Services to streamline issue resolution, share customer feedback, and align on customer success plans.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Business-level fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.</li> <li value="2">Familiarity with the LATAM market.</li> <li value="3">Experience across the full customer journey, including post-sales adoption, value realization, and advocacy.</li> <li value="4">Background in customer success, professional services, technical account management, or a related function with direct customer engagement.</li> <li value="5">Ability to understand and discuss Git, common branching strategies, and how customers use version control in their workflows.</li> <li value="6">Knowledge of the software development lifecycle, including typical development pipelines and tooling.</li> <li value="7">Ability to learn and use GitLab, triage technical questions, share product and infrastructure best practices, and provide hands-on product enablement for customers.</li> <li value="8">Basic-to-intermediate knowledge of development and operations (DevOps), including familiarity with continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps concepts and practices.</li> <li value="9">Skill in translating product usage data and technical details into clear, actionable insights for both technical and executive stakeholders.</li> <li value="10">Proven ability to build trusted relationships with customers and coworkers, facilitate workshops, and guide customers through best practices and operational change.</li> <li value="11">Ability to manage multiple customer needs simultaneously and maintain clear, thorough documentation.</li> <li value="12">Commitment to learning and growing, with a willingness to investigate questions and work through problems independently.</li> <li value="13">Transferable skills from adjacent roles or industries that support collaborative, outcome-focused customer partnerships.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to have</h3> <ul> <li value="1">Prior experience at a startup.</li> <li value="2">Prior experience at a GitLab competitor.</li> <li value="3">Intermediate-to-advanced DevOps knowledge.</li> <li value="4">Prior experience leading executive-level conversations.</li> <li value="5">Prior experience selling services.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Customer Success Management team at GitLab works with customers across regions to drive adoption of the GitLab DevSecOps platform, measure and communicate outcomes, and build long-term advocacy. In this role, you’ll support customers in LATAM as part of a globally distributed, all-remote team. We collaborate asynchronously with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and other groups to connect customer needs with GitLab’s product and services. We focus on helping our customers establish GitLab best practices, including Centers of Excellence, and on turning usage data into actionable insights that support strategic and technical objectives.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. Agents can generate code and tests in seconds, but passing tests don't always mean the software works as intended. You'll contribute to validation approaches and feedback mechanisms that help agents catch that gap and self-correct while they work.</p> <p>This isn't a quality assurance or test automation role. We’re looking for someone who has built with agents, run into the gap between passing tests and working software, and wants to help close it.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own backend features from design through production rollout, making the design calls within the architecture the team agrees on.</li> <li>Build agentic code-review and validation workflows that check whether generated code does what was intended, not just whether its tests pass.</li> <li>Prototype focused validation and feedback mechanisms with your teammates, and use what you learn to improve the platform.</li> <li>Develop language-aware validation approaches, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, adapting techniques to each language while applying a shared definition of trusted software to assess whether agent-generated code delivers the intended behavior.</li> <li>Implement feedback that helps agents identify problems and self-correct during development.</li> <li>Collaborate with engineering teams to test these approaches in real workflows, measure adoption, engineer trust, and validation quality, and use those measurements to evaluate improvements.</li> <li>Participate in code and design reviews, explain implementation trade-offs, and seek feedback on your work.</li> <li>Take part in on-call or operational support where your team's ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience building software with artificial intelligence agents and understanding why their output can pass tests yet fail to behave as intended, from encountering that gap yourself or building something to prevent it.</li> <li>Backend development experience in at least one of Rust, Ruby, Go, or Python, with openness to working across languages.</li> <li>Experience taking backend features from design into production, discussing implementation trade-offs, and knowing when to ask for guidance.</li> <li>Comfort working inside a large existing codebase, not only on greenfield projects.</li> <li>A practical approach to prototyping, learning from results, and turning useful ideas into working software.</li> <li>Clear written communication and the ability to collaborate in an all-remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li>The ability to share decisions transparently and improve your work through iteration and feedback.</li> <li>Familiarity with containerized services; Kubernetes experience is a plus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Trusted Agentic Development team sits within GitLab's Developer Experience group and builds the platforms our engineers rely on every day. We work across engineering teams and programming languages to understand how people use agents, test new approaches in real workflows, and create a shared model of trusted agentic development that teams choose to adopt.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong><em>Poland base salary range:</em></strong><em> zł 248,000 - zł 372,000</em></p> <p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the EU, applicable in the specified country or countries only. You will choose, plan, and run the events and campaigns that create, expand, and accelerate pipeline in your region, and you will move easily between high-level strategy and creative, detailed execution. Staff is a leadership-level individual contributor role: you lead through the work you build and ship, not through direct reports. In a modern marketing organization, that means building and running your own plans, programs, measurement, and AI-assisted automation instead of handing them off, and it suits builders who are comfortable being a leader without a team to manage. Your audience is CIOs, CTOs, VPs of engineering and platform, and the security leaders who govern how their teams ship software. You will judge audience quality by seniority and buying role, not headcount, so you will need to understand how they work and what they want from a vendor.</p> <p>You will support both direct and channel sales teams, work with GitLab partners on Channel and Alliance Marketing activities, and partner with external agencies and third parties to prepare and run campaigns. regional sales goals, and manage events onsite, including logistics, booth staffing, and swag.</li> <li>Project manage every campaign from start to finish, following the GitLab process, so each one plans, and advocate for your sales region within marketing and for marketing with your sales team.</li> <li>Support Channel and Alliance Marketing activities with GitLab partners, from campaign approval through execution.</li> <li>Work with external agencies and third parties to prepare, manage, and execute campaigns.</li> <li>Mentor and guide regional marketing specialists and managers, and lead in building and driving process within the team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven ability to build and execute  a regional strategy, with a record of and regional marketing.</li> <li>Exemplary analytical skills and a proven aptitude for using data to optimize program performance and inform future strategies.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with a proven ability to convey ideas and data clearly in writing and in presentations to a variety of audiences, without a fear of over-communicating. You plan and operate transparently and share best practices with other regional marketers.</li> <li>A proven aptitude for building and driving a budget within your territory, and extreme attention to program details and deadlines.</li> <li>The capacity to empathize with CIOs, CTOs, VPs of engineering and platform, and the security leaders who govern how their teams ship software, and a passion for, and substantial understanding of, the developer tools, IT operations tools, and/or IT security markets.</li> <li>Ability to use GitLab, and you share our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/values/">values</a> and work in accordance with them.</li> <li>Ability to travel up to 50% and to comply with the company’s travel policy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>Regional Marketing at GitLab turns marketing strategy into regional action. We support our sales teams in AMER, EMEA, and APAC by running the events and campaigns that build pipeline in their territories, working with direct sellers, channel sellers, and alliance partners. We work closely with Product Marketing, Corporate Events, Digital Marketing, Marketing Operations, Developer Relations, Business Development, Customer Success Managers, and Solution Architects. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As Director, Social Media, you'll lead GitLab's global social media strategy and help people understand how GitLab is co-creating the future of software development. The role shapes how GitLab shows up across social channels, connecting our company, product, and employer stories, to build meaningful engagement with customers, users, contributors, candidates, and industry audiences. Expect to set clear priorities, guide execution, and use insights to strengthen GitLab's voice and business impact. You'll own the outcomes of GitLab's social function — strategy, budget, team development, tooling, and results — and serve as GitLab's senior-most voice on social strategy with executive stakeholders.</p> <p>This is a player-coach role. You'll set the strategy and stay close enough to the work to write, build, and ship alongside the team. Two Social Media Managers report to the head of corporate communication and work with you on a dotted-line basis. You'll set their strategic direction, raise the editorial and craft bar, and develop them as practitioners, including goal-setting, feedback, and career development in partnership with their manager. Influence matters in this role, which is why it calls for someone who has already led and grown social practitioners. </p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the performance of GitLab's social function and its contribution to marketing and business goals.</li> <li>Lead GitLab's global organic social media strategy, channel plans, and editorial priorities.</li> <li>Own GitLab's YouTube strategy end to end — channel architecture, programming and series development, long- and short-form video, packaging (titles, thumbnails, metadata), search and recommendation optimization, and subscriber and watch-time growth.</li> <li>Partner with Growth Marketing on paid social, including briefing creative, aligning organic and paid on shared audiences and messaging, informing boosting and amplification decisions, and connecting paid performance back to organic strategy.</li> <li>Develop clear, audience-focused campaigns that support company, product, brand, and talent goals.</li> <li>Guide content planning and publishing across social channels while maintaining a consistent GitLab voice.</li> <li>Own the social media budget, tooling stack, and agency, freelance, and production partner relationships.</li> <li>Partner with teams across Marketing, Communications, Product, Sales, Talent Acquisition, and other functions to plan and deliver social programs.</li> <li>Build processes that support effective collaboration in GitLab's all-remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li>Use social listening, audience insights, and performance data to improve content and inform broader marketing decisions.</li> <li>Lead the measurement framework for social — KPIs, dashboards, and reporting cadence — and report performance and learnings to marketing and executive leadership.</li> <li>Partner with DevRel on community engagement to help GitLab participate in relevant industry conversations with a clear, useful point of view.</li> <li>Build and run creator, influencer, and advocacy programs, including developer creators, GitLab community contributors, and team member advocacy.</li> <li>Own GitLab's employee advocacy program — grow participation across Marketing, Sales, Engineering, and Talent, equip team members with content worth sharing, and measure reach, engagement, and contribution to brand and talent goals. Partner with Communications and Talent Acquisition on enablement, and manage the advocacy platform and its adoption.</li> <li>Support executive and expert social presence, partnering with Communications to help GitLab leaders and technical experts show up credibly on social, including constructive conversations with C-suite executives about proposed content.</li> <li>Apply AI tools thoughtfully across the social workflow to help GitLab model what an AI-native marketing team looks like.</li> <li>Prepare for and guide responses to sensitive or fast-moving issues in partnership with the appropriate teams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>10+ years in social media, including at least 5 years leading social strategy for a global brand at the senior manager level or above, and accountable for the function's results.</li> <li>Experience owning a social function end to end, including strategy, budget, headcount, tooling, and results as the accountable leader. </li> <li>Experience leading teams, agencies, and cross-functional programs, with clear ownership of and accountability for outcomes.</li> <li>Depth in YouTube strategy, including owning and growing a brand or business channel, and can speak to programming decisions, video formats, packaging, and the metrics that actually move a channel.</li> <li>Hands-on experience growing LinkedIn and X as primary channels, with judgment about what content, format, and cadence work on each.</li> <li>Experience with paid social programs and how organic and paid social reinforce each other, including creative for paid, audience strategy, and interpreting paid performance data.</li> <li>Experience connecting social media programs to broader brand, communications, product, or business priorities.</li> <li>Strong editorial judgment and the ability to turn complex topics into clear, engaging content.</li> <li>Fluency with short-form and long-form video as core social formats, including working with production partners and creators.</li> <li>Experience defining a measurement framework for social, including KPIs, dashboards, and reporting cadence, and presenting performance, learnings, and recommendations to executive leadership on a standing basis.</li> <li>Experience building or scaling an employee advocacy program, including driving adoption across multiple functions, sustaining participation beyond launch, and reporting attributed reach and business contribution</li> <li>Fluency with an enterprise social stack for publishing, listening, and advocacy. Ours is Sprout Social, Meltwater, and EveryoneSocial.</li> <li>Experience running social programs across multiple regions and languages, and judgment about what to localize versus centralize.</li> <li>Skill in managing multiple priorities and making sound decisions in fast-moving situations.</li> <li>A collaborative, inclusive approach and the ability to work effectively in a distributed, asynchronous environment.</li> <li>Passion about GitLab's mission and the future of software development, open source, artificial intelligence, and DevSecOps.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>This role is part of GitLab's Marketing organization and works across teams to present a clear, consistent company voice on social media. The team collaborates asynchronously with partners across regions and functions, balancing planned campaigns with timely engagement. Together, you'll help audiences understand GitLab's platform, mission, values, and impact.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Staff Backend Engineer, Database Automation (Go)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license.
