Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Senior or Staff Backend Engineer with the <a class="textLink" href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/data-engineering/database-excellence/">Database Excellence group</a>, you'll build and evolve database automation and PostgreSQL as a service capabilities for GitLab. The level will be determined during the hiring process. You'll use Go to automate the full lifecycle of PostgreSQL across GitLab's infrastructure, making database operations safer, more consistent, and easier to scale for databases that sit behind high-throughput, always-on internet services. You'll work closely with partner teams to shape how GitLab provisions and manages PostgreSQL in a fully remote, highly collaborative environment.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li value="1"><a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/database-team/traffic-replay-poc">SQL Traffic Replay Tooling</a>, which validates upgrades and changes against real production workloads.</li> <li value="2"><a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/groups/gitlab-org/database-team/backend/-/work_items/1">PostgreSQL as a Service Platform</a>, which provides standardized, automated provisioning and lifecycle management for internal product databases.</li> <li value="3"><a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/groups/gitlab-com/gl-infra/data-access/dbo/-/work_items/75">PostgreSQL Major Version Upgrade Automation</a>, which supports safe, repeatable major upgrades at GitLab.com scale.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design, build, and maintain Go-based automation that manages the full PostgreSQL lifecycle, including provisioning, configuration, upgrades, failover, scaling, and decommissioning, reducing reactive operational work that currently takes more than 80% of the team's time.</li> <li value="2">Build automation that works across infrastructure-as-code tooling and cloud infrastructure, and evaluate operator-based approaches as the platform evolves.</li> <li value="3">Use AI agents as a regular part of building and operating services, including implementation, review, and reducing repetitive work, while keeping the context agents need in the repository so the whole team can build on it.</li> <li value="4">Build for internet scale by designing automation and services for high-throughput, always-on production workloads, where GitLab.com traffic sets the bar for correctness, latency, and availability.</li> <li value="5">Integrate compute, storage, networking, identity and access management, and managed data services across cloud providers into one coherent PostgreSQL platform instead of creating bespoke setups for each database.</li> <li value="6">Build GitLab's PostgreSQL as a service platform to replace bespoke database setups with standardized, automated provisioning and lifecycle management, so supporting more databases doesn't require growing the operations team at the same rate.</li> <li value="7">Collaborate closely with product management, infrastructure, software delivery, and other engineering teams to design and ship high-performing solutions.</li> <li value="8">Research, design, and implement improvements to PostgreSQL performance, scalability, and data health, helping maintain more than 8 months of operational runway for all critical database saturation points.</li> <li value="9">Review database automation and Go changes from other engineers and contributors, with attention to safety, maintainability, and performance.</li> <li value="10">Document automation practices, PostgreSQL operational patterns, and guidance that helps engineers use and contribute to the platform.</li> <li value="11">Build safe, repeatable automation for PostgreSQL major version upgrades at GitLab.com scale, validating changes against real production traffic before rollout.</li> <li value="12">Operate what you build in production from end to end, using production feedback to guide each iteration.</li> <li value="12">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional software engineering experience working with PostgreSQL in large, complex production environments, including experience building or operating a database-as-a-service product.</li> <li value="2">Proficiency with Go, including designing, implementing, testing, and reviewing backend services.</li> <li value="3">Experience developing Kubernetes operators, controllers, or similar automation for the lifecycle of stateful services, especially databases. Kubernetes experience is one way to demonstrate this skill, but isn't required; comparable experience building database or infrastructure automation is welcome.</li> <li value="4">Comfort with infrastructure as code and core database operations concepts such as high availability, replication, backups, and system-level performance trade-offs.</li> <li value="5">Familiarity with Ruby is a plus but isn't required. Much of GitLab's application codebase uses Ruby on Rails, and being able to read it helps when designing automation that application teams depend on. We’ll expect you to become comfortable with it on the job, not on day one.</li> <li value="6">Strong written communication skills and comfort working asynchronously in an all-remote, distributed team.</li> <li value="7">Self-directed work style with effective organizational skills, the ability to manage priorities as a "manager of one," and alignment with GitLab's values of transparency, collaboration, inclusion, and open source contribution, as well as its <a class="textLink" href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/operating-principles/">operating principles</a>.</li> <li value="8">Ownership of the technical direction for a major initiative such as the PostgreSQL as a service platform, turning an ambiguous problem into an architecture and a sequenced plan that several engineers can execute in parallel.</li> <li value="9">Influence beyond the team, setting the patterns other engineers follow, partnering with sibling database, infrastructure, and platform teams, and growing engineers through design reviews and mentorship.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The <a class="textLink" href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/data-engineering/database-excellence/">Database Excellence group</a> keeps GitLab’s databases running reliably through proactive health management, operational excellence, and strategic enablement. We maintain operational runway by identifying and addressing saturation points, operate infrastructure through automated and scalable processes, and provide tools and frameworks that help teams build features sustainably. Our primary focus is GitLab.com, and we're expanding our scope to provide database health frameworks and tooling that benefit self-managed customers as well.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. experience.</li> <li value="5">Collaborate asynchronously with product, data, infrastructure, security, and AI counterparts to clarify requirements, align on scope, and ship features safely for customers and sustainably for the team.</li> <li value="6">Use AI-assisted development workflows responsibly (for example, using Knowledge Graph-backed agents and internal Duo tooling), and share what works with the team while keeping a strong focus on code quality and correctness.</li> <li value="7">Participate in code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and pairing to both learn from others and help maintain consistent standards across the codebase.</li> <li value="8">Contribute across the stack when needed, including occasional Ruby work for Rails integration and authorization paths, or small frontend changes related to Knowledge Graph features (for example, Software Architecture Map UI plumbing).</li> <li value="8">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll bring</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience building and maintaining backend systems in production, with an understanding of reliability, maintainability, and how to support services over time (for example, incident response and follow-ups).</li> <li value="2">Proficiency in at least one modern backend language and strong interest in Rust, with either prior Rust experience or clear evidence you can ramp quickly and deliver in a Rust-first, performance-sensitive codebase.</li> <li value="3">Some exposure to distributed data or analytics systems (for example, OLAP databases, Kafka- or NATS-style messaging, or change data capture (CDC) pipelines), or strong motivation to develop those skills in this role.</li> <li value="4">Interest in graph data modeling and query patterns (property graphs, multi-step (n-hop) traversals, aggregations), and willingness to learn the tools and concepts used in Knowledge Graph over time.</li> <li value="5">Practical experience (or strong interest) using AI tools in day-to-day development, along with a thoughtful approach to validating outputs and integrating AI into your workflow.</li> <li value="6">A language-agnostic mindset and evidence that you can pick up new languages and frameworks as needed (for example, Ruby, Go, or TypeScript/Vue where the work touches adjacent systems).</li> <li value="7">Solid fundamentals in system design for your level, including the ability to reason about trade-offs, ask good questions, and align your implementation work with documented architectural decisions.</li> <li value="8">Comfort working in a low-process, high-ownership environment where you take responsibility for your work, refine problem statements with teammates, and communicate progress clearly in writing across time zones in an all-remote team.</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong class="textBold">About the team</strong></strong></p> <p>GitLab Orbit sits within the Data Engineering organization. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. from queue-based job orchestration to a durable workflow engine.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Lead, hire, and grow a team of site reliability engineers and backend engineers, supporting career development, promotions, and onboarding.</li> <li value="2">Own reliability for the job processing and caching platforms, including service-level objectives, error budgets, alerting, deadlines can't be met.</li> <li value="4">Run the team's part of GitLab.com's first-tier on-call rotation, including shift coverage, onboarding, and handovers, and serve as incident commander for high-severity incidents.</li> <li value="5">Drive zero-downtime Redis version upgrades and automate operating system patching and reboots.</li> <li value="6">Adapt job processing to run in single-tenant and cell-based deployments.</li> <li value="7">Own the migration from queue-based job orchestration to a durable workflow engine, defining the first use cases, a measurable migration delivering high-performance services at scale, ideally site reliability engineers or infrastructure engineers running production software as a service systems.</li> <li value="2">Technical depth in background job processing and caching technologies such as Redis and Sidekiq, sufficient to guide decisions about upgrades, capacity, and failure modes.</li> <li value="3">Experience managing reliability against service-level objectives, including defining service-level indicators, setting up burn-rate alerting, and planning capacity.</li> <li value="4">Experience running a 24/7 on-call rotation and coordinating high-severity incidents.</li> <li value="5">A track record of balancing operational work and incident follow-ups with roadmap projects, and pushing back on scope when deadlines can't be met.</li> <li value="6">Experience leading a fully remote team across time zones in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Async team runs GitLab.com's background processing layer, from the Sidekiq infrastructure to the shared code that enqueues jobs. Product teams build the jobs; we keep the platform that runs them fast and reliable. Our Redis clusters support caching, sessions, rate limiting, queues, and shared state. We also support data durability through backup and restore verification, object storage, and operational support for Git repository storage. That work includes restore drills, capacity rebalancing, and provisioning. title: Red Team Lead
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. What we're looking for We're looking for a Red Team Lead to establish our Red Team and strengthen the security culture at Supabase. As the team lead, you'll build the team and work alongside them to plan and execute realistic attack simulations across the entire tech stack. You'll guide the team to turn findings into practical recommendations that drive meaningful security improvements. This role is ideal for someone who combines technical expertise with thoughtful, people-first leadership. Success in this role means our team brings security at Supabase to new heights. WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Develop our Red Team from the ground up. - Lead and mentor a team that values technical depth, curiosity, collaboration, and accountability, where people can challenge ideas and learn. Align their efforts with their career growth and organizational security goals. - Stay technically connected to the planning and execution of operations. Guide the team to make sound judgment calls and communicate operational impact to various audiences. - Define the team's strategic roadmap and operational practices for our environment and threat landscape. Use metrics and impact narratives to communicate the team's success. - Build strategic relationships with relevant teams, including Legal, Engineering, IT, HR, and Finance, for cross-functional influence and amplified security impact. Foster a collaborative relationship with defensive teams. - Advise leadership on strategic growth beyond the Red Team. - Establish Supabase as a thought leader in the security space. Share appropriate research and lessons publicly through writing or talks. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Have experience leading adversary emulation teams, especially balancing hands-on work and management as a player-coach. - Have experience with global asynchronous teams and can work independently. - Are familiar with cloud-native offensive operations, including cloud and CI/CD pipelines, and creating and securely deploying command-and-control (C2), reconnaissance tools, and infrastructure for adversary simulations. - Understand attack techniques targeting browsers, cloud infrastructure, databases, SaaS applications, supply chains, Linux and macOS devices, and identity and access systems. - Naturally build rapport, trust, and engagement within Security and across the organization. - Work collaboratively with kindness and respect. - Can clearly communicate complex security concepts to a wide range of audiences, including executive leadership. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Solutions Consultant, Enterprise, France

Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot in front of a customer without a specialist in the room - Strong prospecting, discovery and qualification instincts, with the ability to map customer workflows and translate them into commercial outcomes and adoption plans - title: General Counsel (remote)
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel</strong> to lead Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function and to build the legal architecture a public company needs — commercial contracting, corporate governance, intellectual property and compliance — in a software business that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will report to the Chief Operating Officer and advise the CEO, CFO and the Board directly.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: This role can be home-based in EMEA, or office-based in our London, UK office.</p> <h3><strong>About our team</strong></h3> <p>Canonical’s Legal and Compliance function is a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. It owns the terms on which Ubuntu and our commercial products reach the market: open source and intellectual property licensing, enterprise and channel contracting, data protection, export controls and trade, competition, and the governance a company preparing to list has to be able to evidence.</p> <p>Canonical is founder-led, profitable and growing, and privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. That makes this a function in transition. The work is as much building the architecture — a management layer across two regions, standard contracting positions, controls, policies and records — as it is advising on live matters, and it is done in a company that regularly does things the industry has not done before, so the precedents often do not exist.</p> <p>The team works with Product and Engineering on licensing and IP, with Security on customer assurance, with Finance on listing readiness and controls, and with Sales on the commitments we make to customers. As General Counsel you lead that team, set its standards, and advise the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board and its committees directly.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead the global Legal and Compliance function: set its structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas, so the business gets consistent answers wherever it operates.</li> <li>Build the management layer: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>Set the operating cadence of the function: how legal work is taken in and prioritised, what internal clients can expect and when, and how workload and risk are reported to the leadership team.</li> <li>Own public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance.</li> <li>Advise the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and support Board and committee meetings.</li> <li>Own the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed.</li> <li>Lead intellectual property and open source licensing strategy: permissive and copyleft licences, trademark, and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed.</li> <li>Own the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition, and AI regulation.</li> <li>Manage litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, and own the external counsel panel, its budget and the quality of its work.</li> <li>Advise on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Qualified as a lawyer, with a law degree or equivalent and an active licence to practise in an EMEA or Americas jurisdiction.</li> <li>In-house legal leadership in a software or technology company — a business that licenses its own products, rather than one that buys technology to run its operations.</li> <li>Commercial technology contracting: enterprise software and subscription agreements, channel and reseller agreements, cloud and services, and hardware manufacturer agreements.</li> <li>Open source licensing: permissive and copyleft licences, trademark, and how open source communities work in practice.</li> <li>Corporate governance for a listed company, or for one preparing to list: board and committee support, delegated authority, disclosure and controls.</li> <li>Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.</li> <li>Leading a distributed legal team, including managing managers across regions and time zones.</li> <li>Building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.</li> <li>A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under-performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English, with excellent drafting and presentation skills.</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally two to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience taking a company through an IPO, or practising as counsel inside a listed company.</li> <li>A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.</li> <li>A qualification in more than one jurisdiction.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How we work</strong></p> <p>We look for a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results, backed by self-motivation and drive. Our people deliver their work precisely, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity. Reliability is at our core, where colleagues deliver high quality work that builds trust and confidence. We make ourselves accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable. Finally we are adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</p> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Manager, Forward Deployed Architect, Japan & Korea
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE As Manager, Forward Deployed Architect, Japan & Korea, you will lead a team that helps enterprise customers turn AI ambition into operational reality. You will manage and develop Forward Deployed Architects across Japan and Korea, helping customers build meaningful workflows and solutions while establishing the practices that enable consistent, high-quality delivery. This is a player-coach role for a builder, seller, and people leader. Your primary impact will come through the performance and growth of your team, rather than through personally owning delivery. You will stay close to customers and engagements, working with account teams from presales through delivery, coaching your team, and contributing hands-on when needed. You will report to the Head of Services, Forward Deployed, APAC. You will partner with Solutions Consultants and Outcome Architects to identify opportunities, shape engagements, and connect proposed solutions to customer outcomes. You will also manage staffing and delivery, support commercial and contractual processes, and build repeatable ways of working with internal teams and service partners. You will partner with Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) managers on engagements that require engineering expertise. The FDA organization owns time-bound Services engagements, including discovery, solution architecture, implementation, launch readiness, enablement, outcome delivery, and handoff. FDE owns engineering-intensive implementation requiring production code or deep technical specialization. Together, you will establish clear engagement boundaries, staffing and escalation mechanisms, quality standards, and a unified customer experience. This is an opportunity to help define what forward-deployed work looks like at Notion as we evolve into an Agent OS. You will help customers put new AI-powered workflows into practice, share what works with partners, and shape an emerging service in a fast-changing environment. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE Customer delivery - Guide the Japan and Korea portfolio from discovery and solution design through implementation, enablement, and handoff, keeping customer outcomes at the center of each engagement. - Review delivery health, scope, budget, timelines, and risks; coach team members through challenges and support escalations and change requests. - Stay close to strategic engagements and customer stakeholders, providing guidance and executive support when needed. - Assign the right team members to engagements, establish co-delivery approaches, and provide hands-on implementation support when needed. - Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and other stakeholders when engagements require engineering expertise, with clear ownership and handoffs. - Improve delivery quality and consistency through playbooks, templates, reference architectures, quality reviews, and lessons learned, developed and shared with teams and service partners. Pre-sales and solution scoping - Partner with Solutions Consultants, Outcome Architects, and account teams to identify customer needs and opportunities for paid and unpaid Services engagements. - Lead or support discovery and shape proposals, defining desired business outcomes, solution approach, deliverables, implementation plans, timelines, and risks. - Qualify and prioritize incoming opportunities against customer needs, commercial value, delivery risk, and available capacity. Make clear decisions to accept, defer, redirect, or decline work. - Develop a target-account strategy and proactively drive joint Services proposals with Solutions Consultants during your first six months. - Manage Services opportunities and forecasts, and support customer contracts, waivers, and change orders throughout the engagement lifecycle. - Turn recurring customer needs into packaged solutions, and share field insights and lessons with regional peers, Product, Engineering, PMM, and Services leadership. Team management and operations - Hire, onboard, manage, and retain Forward Deployed Architects across Japan and Korea, setting clear expectations and managing performance against the FDA levels framework. - Develop team members through engagement reviews, shadowing, work-product feedback, coaching, and regular career conversations. - Turn delivery experience into practical guidance and training; set standards for discovery, solution architecture, implementation, engagement leadership, and customer enablement. - Manage staffing and capacity across presales and delivery, matching work to skills and availability while protecting time for onboarding, coaching, and reusable assets. - Build effective operating practices and run a regular cadence to review pipeline, demand, allocation, delivery health, and risks, adjusting priorities as needs change. - Collaborate with FDA and FDE managers in other regions to share engagement updates, learning, and best practices. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - 5+ years of experience in professional services, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing technology role. - Experience across the enterprise services lifecycle, from presales and discovery through proposals, contract management, and delivery. Strong commercial and delivery judgment, including estimation, margin awareness, risk, change control, and escalation. - Experience managing and developing a team, including hiring, onboarding, feedback, performance management, career development, and team health. - Ability to turn personal expertise into repeatable coaching, training, and standards that improve team performance, and experience developing packaged services or reusable delivery methods and assets. - Experience managing staffing and capacity across concurrent engagements, and designing intake and prioritization processes that balance customer urgency, strategic value, delivery risk, and available capacity. - Hands-on experience building and delivering technology or AI solutions, with tangible examples and a builder mindset. Technical fluency across areas such as AI workflows, enterprise systems, APIs, integrations, data, automation, and governance; production coding is not required, but you must be able to reason through tradeoffs and partner credibly with FDE. - Strong customer-facing discovery, communication, problem-solving, and solution architecture skills, with the ability to review complex work, guide teams, and align stakeholders around outcomes. - Fluency in Japanese and English, and the ability to work across teams and customers in Japan and Korea. - Comfort navigating ambiguity, learning quickly, and adapting strategy and execution as the business evolves. NICE TO HAVES - Fluency in Korean. - Experience designing, building, or selling AI agent workflows. - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCP, Workers, coding agents, or developer-platform workflows. Prior Notion experience is not required. - Experience partnering with engineering teams and service partners on customer engagements. - Experience building or improving a team, practice, or operating model. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. title: Candidate Experience Specialist, Contractor (AUS)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>This is a contract opportunity*</strong></h4> <h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>As a Candidate Experience Specialist, you'll shape how candidates experience GitLab from first touch through offer and handoff to our People Operations team. You'll be a key partner to Recruiters, hiring managers, and recruiting leadership, helping them execute hiring plans, coordinate interviews, and maintain accurate, transparent processes in our applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories. You'll act as a brand ambassador who embodies our values in every interaction, ensuring candidates receive timely, thoughtful communication and a consistent, high quality experience across a high volume of roles. You’ll focus on building strong relationships with hiring teams, improving and standardizing coordination workflows, and supporting GitLab's goal of hiring a qualified, diverse, and motivated team in our all-remote, global environment.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Recruiters, hiring teams, and Recruiting leadership to understand and execute the hiring plan for each job requisition.</li> <li>Coordinate with Recruiters to maintain accurate, up-to-date hiring process information in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories.</li> <li>Manage candidate scheduling and act as the Recruiting Coordinator to organize interviews and keep hiring processes running smoothly.</li> <li>Ensure candidates receive timely, thoughtful, and engaging communication at each stage of the hiring process.</li> <li>Help manage candidate traffic for all roles, monitoring pipelines and flagging issues or bottlenecks to the recruiting team.</li> <li>Create and stage employment contracts for candidates receiving offers on behalf of hiring managers and Recruiters.</li> <li>Partner with People Operations to create a seamless handoff for new team members joining GitLab.</li> <li>Promote GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction, acting as a brand ambassador for potential team members.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting end to end hiring processes in partnership with recruiters and hiring managers, ideally in a fast paced or high volume environment.</li> <li>Skill using an applicant tracking system to schedule, track, and move candidates through interview stages; Greenhouse experience is beneficial but not required.</li> <li>Proficiency with Google Workspace, scheduling tools,  and a willingness to learn and use additional tools.</li> <li>Ability to communicate clearly and professionally in writing and verbally with candidates and internal stakeholders at all levels, including executives.</li> <li>Demonstrated strength in organization, time management, and prioritization, with a consistent focus on meeting deadlines and maintaining attention to detail.</li> <li>Ability to build collaborative relationships with team members across time zones and functions while maintaining a high level of confidentiality.</li> <li>Interest in learning about talent acquisition and contributing to an inclusive hiring process that attracts a qualified, diverse, and motivated team.</li> <li>Alignment with GitLab's values and comfort working in an all remote, asynchronous environment, including flexibility in your working hours to support candidates and hiring teams across multiple time zones, with openness to transferable experience from related coordination or operations roles.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Candidate Experience team partners with Recruiters, hiring managers, and People Operations to run a smooth, consistent, and inclusive hiring process across GitLab's all-remote, global organization. You'll join a collaborative group that coordinates interview logistics, manages candidate flow in our applicant tracking system, and supports offer and onboarding handoffs so candidates and hiring teams have a clear, organized experience at every stage. The team works asynchronously across time zones, using GitLab and shared documentation to stay aligned while handling high-volume hiring. Our focus is on refining processes, maintaining accurate data, and acting as brand ambassadors for GitLab's values in every candidate interaction.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Multigres Deployment Engineer
description: Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. We're looking for an engineer to own the deployment and operational infrastructure of Multigres, our distributed Postgres platform. You'll be responsible for building and maintaining the Multigres Operator, ensuring reliable cloud deployments, and creating the tooling that powers our Kubernetes-based infrastructure. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Build and maintain the Multigres Operator - Maintain our Go-based Kubernetes operator that orchestrates distributed Postgres deployments - Architect cloud deployment infrastructure - Design and implement robust deployment patterns for EKS and other Kubernetes platforms - Manage storage and networking layers - Work with CSI drivers, persistent volumes, and cross-cloud networking to ensure data reliability and connectivity - Develop deployment tooling - Create internal tools and automation for provisioning, scaling, and managing Multigres clusters - Ensure operational excellence - Build monitoring, alerting, and diagnostic capabilities into the deployment layer - Collaborate across teams - Work with database engineers, SRE, and product teams to deliver seamless deployment experiences YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE: - Strong systems programming skills - Proficiency in Go and experience building production-grade operators or controllers - Deep Kubernetes expertise - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes internals, custom resources, and cloud-managed Kubernetes services (EKS, GKE, AKS) - Database operations knowledge - Understanding of database deployment patterns, backup/restore, replication, and high availability - Distributed systems experience - Familiarity with consensus protocols, failure scenarios, and designing for resilience - Cloud infrastructure background - Experience with cloud-native deployment tooling, IaC (Terraform, Pulumi), and cloud provider APIs - Production operations mindset - Track record of building reliable, observable, and maintainable systems NICE TO HAVE: - Experience with CSI storage drivers and storage orchestration in Kubernetes - Knowledge of cross-cloud networking tools like Cilium, Istio, or similar service mesh technologies - Prior work with sharded query serving systems like Vitess - Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

You'll turn GitLab's safety and resilience strategies into practical programs that work across countries, both day to day and when a crisis disrupts how people work.</p> <h3><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll do</strong></strong></h3> <ul> <li value="1">Run the occupational health and safety management system in line with ISO 45001. Put the global policy into practice through hazard identification, risk and ergonomic assessments, incident reporting and investigation, performance measurement, internal audits, and management reviews.</li> <li value="2">Identify and meet each country's legal safety obligations with Employment Law, People Compliance, Benefits, and local vendors. Track changes in the law and keep records of required appointments, assessments, committees, training, and medical surveillance. Manage vendor agreements and keep safety and resilience services within budget.</li> <li value="3">Coordinate required consultation with works councils and team members before GitLab makes a decision or contacts affected team members outside the consultation process. Prepare consultation materials, participate in health and safety committees where they exist, and retain the consent, hearing, and anonymized reporting records each jurisdiction requires.</li> <li value="4">Run the workplace violence prevention program. Coordinate the threat management team, train managers, and keep case records and legally required local plans up to date.</li> <li value="5">Coordinate crisis response and disaster relief. Keep the crisis plan and records current, with a lead and alternate for every role. During on-call shifts, follow escalation procedures and support the crisis team until the response ends. Work with the relief partner to track the Team Member Disaster Relief fund balance and handle communications and reporting.</li> <li value="6">Maintain continuity plans for the People Group, assess the impact of disruptions, and prioritize recovery of essential services. Keep records for auditors and insurers, run crisis and continuity exercises, lead required reviews after incidents, and track follow-up actions until they're complete.</li> <li value="7">Assess each requirement in ISO 45001, ISO 22361, and ISO 22301. Each week, review the scores produced by AI agents and correct any errors. Set deadlines for improvements and report quarterly on the safety and resilience measures in the People Safety & Security scorecard.</li> <li value="8">Lead people safety and crisis response on site at major company events alongside security operations. Confirm emergency procedures and medical arrangements are in place, serve as the crisis team's on-site contact, and lead a review after each event.</li> </ul> <h3><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll bring</strong></strong></h3> <ul> <li value="1">Experience delivering safety and resilience programs across several countries, covering occupational health and safety plus either crisis management or business continuity.</li> <li value="2">Knowledge of when to consult team members or works councils, hold hearings, or make decisions jointly, and how to document each step. title: Software Engineer, Collections Infra
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Software Engineer on Collections Infra, you’ll help scale the infrastructure behind Notion’s database block. Databases power views, boards, charts, forms, and the workflows customers use to run their companies; as Notion grows into larger enterprise deployments and AI-native work, those systems need to become faster, more reliable, and ready for much higher concurrency. This team sits between infrastructure and product, building backend architecture that improves the customer experience while becoming a platform other Notion teams can build on. You’ll work on problems like database load performance, microservices, high-volume writes from agents, and the flexibility that makes Notion databases powerful and hard to scale. This role can be based in either San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - By your 90th day, you’ll understand how Collections Infra supports Notion’s database block, ship improvements to database performance or reliability, and build context on the scale challenges behind larger enterprise workspaces and AI-driven write volume. - You’ll use AI as a real engineering collaborator: to learn unfamiliar systems faster, explore debugging paths, generate tests, summarize traces or logs, and pressure-test implementation plans before shipping. - You’ll contribute to the team’s work to make databases faster and more reliable at P95 scale, especially as customers build larger centralized databases with more concurrent usage. - By the end of your first year, you’ll have helped raise the quality bar for Collections infrastructure through better architecture, observability, documentation, or system boundaries that make future work easier to build on. - You’ll partner with senior engineers and product-facing teams to evolve Collections as a platform, balancing internal developer needs with the external customer experience of databases. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Strong backend engineering fundamentals, with interest in performance, reliability, scalability, and systems that need to hold up under real customer load. - Curiosity about distributed systems, microservices, and data-layer trade-offs; experience in these areas is helpful, but we care most about your ability to learn quickly and reason from first principles. - Practical comfort with JavaScript or TypeScript, or the ability to ramp quickly in a codebase where those tools matter. - Grit and truth-seeking in technical problem solving: you can iterate when the first approach does not move P50/P95 performance, and you’re motivated by finding the real bottleneck. - A self-guided learning style: you use docs, code, teammates, and AI to build context, ask better questions, and turn ambiguity into steady progress. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Content Reviewer - United States
description: Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust. In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information. Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models Qualifications to succeed in this project: Professional fluency in English Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher) Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred) Why join the project: Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset. Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance Qualification path How to get started: Complete your contributor profile and application Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training Receive your project assignment and access credentials Service Rates The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

title: Storage Platform Engineer
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE Supabase runs millions of Postgres databases, and storage performance is now one of the biggest levers on how fast, reliable, and affordable they are. We're building a software-defined, NVMe-over-Fabrics storage platform underneath Supabase Postgres. Postgres stays unmodified, and the new layer delivers near-local-NVMe performance with the durability and flexibility of networked storage. As the senior engineer driving storage, you'll own this effort end to end: the architecture and build-vs-buy decisions, integration into our compute platform, and operating the system in production. Your first goal is raw Postgres I/O performance at scale. In the longer term, the layer you build will provide the block-level snapshots and copy-on-write clones behind database branching, fast restores, and instant resizes. Because it's software-defined, it will also travel with us as we expand beyond a single cloud provider into multi-cloud and colocated infrastructure. This is a foundational, high-ownership role. You'll set the technical direction for storage at Supabase and help grow the team around it. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Lead the architecture of Supabase's NVMe-oF storage platform, including evaluating and deciding between adopting existing software-defined storage and building on SPDK - Integrate networked block storage into our Kubernetes-based compute platform through CSI drivers and custom controllers, covering provisioning, attach/detach, resizing, and migration - Make Postgres fast on networked storage by profiling and tuning the full I/O path, from fsync, WAL, and checkpoints through the kernel block layer, NVMe/TCP, and the network - Design for durability and availability, including replication or erasure coding, failure domains, failover, and data-integrity verification - Build I/O isolation and QoS so that noisy neighbors can't degrade other tenants - Set performance and reliability SLOs, and build the benchmarking and observability to hold the system to them - Design the layer for block-level snapshots and copy-on-write clones, laying the groundwork for database branching - Keep the platform portable across AWS, other clouds, and bare-metal/colo - Write design docs, mentor engineers, and work closely with the Compute, Branching, Postgres, and Multicloud teams - Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident reviews - Resolve escalated support issues, while also identifying and resolving systemic issues across the platform YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU MUST HAVE: - Have 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time building and operating storage systems in production - Have built or operated distributed or software-defined block storage (for example Ceph RBD, Lightbits, Simplyblock, Portworx, LINSTOR/DRBD, or an in-house system) - Have hands-on experience with NVMe/TCP or NVMe-oF, including targets, initiators, multipath, and failover behavior - Have a deep understanding of Linux storage internals: the block layer, io_uring, page cache, O_DIRECT and fsync semantics, filesystems, and device-mapper - Write strong systems code in Go, plus C, C++, or Rust - Measure performance rigorously with fio, pgbench, eBPF, and perf, and can explain latency down to its individual components - Understand durability tradeoffs between replication, erasure coding, and consistency under failure - Have led technical direction on a complex system: design docs, tradeoffs, and bringing others along - Have experience with Kubernetes controllers and/or CSI drivers - Have been on call for large production systems - Communicate clearly in writing and thrive in async, globally distributed teams NICE TO HAVE: - SPDK development experience - RDMA/RoCE experience - Experience implementing block-level snapshots, thin provisioning, or copy-on-write cloning - Postgres internals knowledge (WAL, buffer manager, checkpointer), or familiarity with OrioleDB - Experience with AWS networking and instance storage at scale (ENA, placement, bandwidth limits) - Experience running storage on bare metal or in colo - Contributions to open source storage projects or the Linux kernel storage stack WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

Ability to evaluate AI-generated work, protect confidential information, and share responsible workflows with team members.</li> <li value="8">Technology or business-to-business (B2B) software recruiting experience is helpful, not required.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>You'll join a globally distributed, remote-first Talent Acquisition team where clear communication and reliable follow-through matter. In your first year, you build trusted relationships across their teams and with partner EBAs. You establish reliable processes for meeting preparation and follow-through, travel, expenses, recruiting coordination, team events and offsites, and the cross-functional requests that come with customer escalations. This role is based in the United States or Canada and requires Pacific time hours (about 8 AM to 5 PM PT) and some flexibility to support meetings across global time zones. Provide coverage and share practices across the executive business administrator community.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting VP-level or senior leaders, ideally in a fast-paced software, SaaS or AI environment (engineering or CTO exposure is a plus), with an understanding of their planning cycles and reviews.</li> <li>Experience managing complex calendars, travel, expenses, and shifting priorities for multiple senior leaders, with sound judgment about competing requests.</li> <li>Experience running all-hands and offsites end to end for teams of 200 or more in a remote or hybrid setting, including managing dependencies and responding to disruptions.</li> <li>A project management approach: define owners, due dates, and next steps; anticipate risks; and keep multiple workstreams moving independently. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2 id="h.4x3v2cmvixi0">An overview of this role</h2> <p>As an Executive Assistant in GitLab’s Marketing organization, you’ll support the Vice President (VP) of Growth Marketing and the VP of Product and Technical Marketing, reporting to the VP of Growth Marketing. You’ll help both leaders focus on their highest-impact work across teams spanning digital experience, marketing operations, events, community and developer relations, campaigns, product marketing, and launches. Beyond calendar management, you’ll join leadership discussions, keep projects and recurring meetings moving, and connect the leaders with their organizations through a monthly launch rhythm. In your first year, you’ll build trusted relationships with both leaders, their teams, and the other executive support partners, and establish reliable processes for scheduling, meeting preparation, travel, events, recruiting coordination, and expenses. You’ll anticipate needs four to six weeks ahead and follow commitments through to completion. You’ll move quickly, build AI-powered workflows to automate recurring work, and be a warm, approachable partner to the people on both leaders’ teams.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own high-volume calendars across time zones for both leaders, connecting meeting priorities to quarterly goals and business rhythms. Protect focus time, recommend how to prioritize or delegate requests, and provide inbox triage when requested.</li> <li>Prepare leadership meetings, all-hands, and the monthly in-person launch review: coordinate agendas, pre-reads, and attendance, keep time, and capture and follow up on action items.</li> <li>Maintain the leadership project tracker and weekly leadership, monthly goals, and quarterly business reviews. Build work-back plans, follow up with owners, and flag delays, deadlines, and decisions so the right people stay involved and informed.</li> <li>Partner with senior directors and team leads across both organizations, helping when it moves the leaders’ priorities and bringing the leaders in when it matters.</li> <li>Support team connection by remembering milestones and getting notes, gifts, or flowers out quickly.</li> <li>Coordinate domestic and international travel, including transportation, lodging, security needs, and documentation. Arrange alternatives when plans change, and prepare accurate monthly expense reports with receipts and reconciliation.</li> <li>Plan team offsites, leadership working sessions, and company kickoffs from start to finish, working with event partners and confirming reservations, deposits, and logistics through completion.</li> <li>Partner with Recruiting and hiring teams on interviews, candidate communication, and onboarding logistics, and with People, information technology (IT), and Security on team needs. Provide coverage for executive support partners, help onboard new support partners, and take on Marketing special projects.</li> <li>Build and maintain artificial intelligence (AI) workflows, with Claude as our standard, to automate research, drafting, meeting summaries, and recurring administrative work. Check outputs for accuracy and context rather than relying on automated summaries alone.</li> <li>Identify recurring friction in how the teams work, and propose and implement improvements to processes and documentation.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience supporting two or more VP-level leaders simultaneously at a fast-growing company, ideally SaaS or AI-forward, adapting to distinct working styles and business priorities.</li> <li>A bias for action and ownership: you move from ask to done quickly, act independently within agreed priorities, and
